WITH TopQualifiers AS (

        qualifying

),

    FROM 
        TopQualifiers
)

FROM 
    TopQualifiers tq
JOIN 
    MaxQ1Value m ON tq.q1 = m.max_q1
JOIN 
    drivers d ON tq.driverId = d.driverId;

SELECT 
    ABS(inpatient_count - outpatient_count) AS difference,
    ROUND(ABS((inpatient_count - outpatient_count) * 100.0 / (inpatient_count + outpatient_count)), 2) AS percentage_difference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
) AS patient_counts;

WITH InpatientCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS InpatientCount 
    FROM Patient 
    WHERE Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M'
),
OutpatientCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS OutpatientCount 
    FROM Patient 
    WHERE Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M'
),
TotalMaleCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalMaleCount 
    FROM Patient 
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN ic.InpatientCount > oc.OutpatientCount THEN 'Inpatients have more males'
        ELSE 'Outpatients have more males'
    END AS Result,
    ((ic.InpatientCount - oc.OutpatientCount) * 100.0 / tm.TotalMaleCount) AS PercentageDeviation
FROM InpatientCount ic, OutpatientCount oc, TotalMaleCount tm;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+') >
             (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-') 
        THEN 'More Inpatient Male Patients'
        ELSE 'More Outpatient Male Patients'
    END AS Conclusion,
    ABS((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+') - 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-')) * 100 /
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M') AS Deviation_Percentage;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MaleInPatients > MaleOutPatients THEN 'More Male In Patients'
    ELSE 'More Male Out Patients'
  END AS ComparisonResult,
  ABS(MaleInPatients - MaleOutPatients) AS AbsoluteDifference,
  ROUND((ABS(MaleInPatients - MaleOutPatients) * 100.0 / MaleInPatients), 2) AS PercentageDifference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    SUM(IIF(SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+', 1, 0)) AS MaleInPatients,
    SUM(IIF(SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-', 1, 0)) AS MaleOutPatients
  FROM Patient
);

SELECT

    ) AS "Percentage Difference"

WITH EligibleFreeRateCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.School Name,
        (f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS EligibleFreeRate
    FROM 
        frpm f
    INNER JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s."School Type" = 'Continuation'
),
RankedEligibleFreeRateCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        "School Name",
        EligibleFreeRate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY EligibleFreeRate ASC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        EligibleFreeRateCTE
)
SELECT 
    "School Name",
    EligibleFreeRate
FROM 
    RankedEligibleFreeRateCTE
WHERE 
    Rank <= 3;

WITH EligibleFreeRateCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        T1.CDSCode,
        T1.School,
        T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EligibleFreeRate
    FROM 
        schools T1
    INNER JOIN 
        frpm T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        T1.StatusType = 'Continuation'
),
RankedEligibleFreeRateCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        School,
        EligibleFreeRate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY EligibleFreeRate ASC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        EligibleFreeRateCTE
)
SELECT 
    School,
    EligibleFreeRate
FROM 
    RankedEligibleFreeRateCTE
WHERE 
    Rank <= 3;

WITH SchoolData AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS Enrollment_5to17,
        f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS FreeMealCount_5to17,
        s.StatusType
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
),
EligibleFreeRate AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.CDSCode,
        (sd.FreeMealCount_5to17 * 100.0 / sd.Enrollment_5to17) AS EligibleFreeRate_5to17
    FROM SchoolData sd
    WHERE sd.StatusType = 'Continuation'
)
SELECT 
    efr.EligibleFreeRate_5to17
FROM (
    SELECT 
        efr.EligibleFreeRate_5to17,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY efr.EligibleFreeRate_5to17 ASC) AS rank
    FROM EligibleFreeRate efr
) efr
WHERE efr.rank <= 3;

WITH SchoolData AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS EligibleFreeRate
    FROM 
        frpm f
    INNER JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.StatusType = 'Continuation'
)
SELECT 
    EligibleFreeRate
FROM 
    SchoolData
ORDER BY 
    EligibleFreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH EligibleFreeRate AS (

WITH TotalConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth
    WHERE 
        SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY 
        CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotalConsumption
    FROM 
        TotalConsumption
)
SELECT 
    tc.CustomerID
FROM 
    TotalConsumption tc
JOIN 
    MinConsumption mc ON tc.TotalConsumption = mc.MinTotalConsumption;

WITH CustomerConsumptionCTE AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM
        customers c
    INNER JOIN
        yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY
        c.CustomerID
),
MinConsumptionCTE AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotalConsumption
    FROM
        CustomerConsumptionCTE
)
SELECT
    cc.CustomerID
FROM
    CustomerConsumptionCTE cc
INNER JOIN
    MinConsumptionCTE mc ON cc.TotalConsumption = mc.MinTotalConsumption;

SELECT 
    AVG(oxygen_count) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'O' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count
    FROM 
        molecule m
    JOIN 
        atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        m.molecule_id IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
            FROM bond b
            WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
        )
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts;

WITH SingleBondedMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
),
OxygenAtomCounts AS (
    SELECT sm.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM SingleBondedMolecules sm
    JOIN atom a ON sm.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'O'
    GROUP BY sm.molecule_id
)
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM OxygenAtomCounts;

SELECT CAST(SUM(oxygen_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS avg_oxygen_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts
JOIN molecule m ON oxygen_counts.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'O' AND b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts;

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS avg_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
      AND a.element = 'O'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts;

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonded_atoms_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS single_bond_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND a.atom_id IN (
        SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id = b.bond_id
    )
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS subquery;

WITH SingleBondsPerMolecule AS (
    SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T2.bond_id) as single_bond_count
    FROM molecule AS T1
    INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
    WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.label = '+'
    GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
)
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) as avg_single_bond_count
FROM SingleBondsPerMolecule;

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / CAST(COUNT(a.atom_id) AS REAL) AS avg_single_bonded_carbon_count
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN 
    bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND a.atom_id IN (b.atom_id, b.atom_id2)
WHERE 
    m.label = '+'
GROUP BY 
    m.molecule_id;

    FROM molecule m

    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS subquery;

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonded_carbon_molecules

        SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM

    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'CZK' AND

),
MaxConsumption AS (

)
SELECT

FROM

        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS total_consumption

    WHERE

),
RankedCustomers AS (

    FROM

WITH OldestFemaleClient AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, d.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM client c
    INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
MaxAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT MAX(d.A11) AS max_avg_salary
    FROM client c
    INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
)
SELECT o.client_id, m.max_avg_salary - o.avg_salary AS salary_difference
FROM OldestFemaleClient o, MaxAvgSalary m;

WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, d.A11 as AvgSalary, c.birth_date
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
OldestFemaleClients AS (
    SELECT client_id, AvgSalary
    FROM FemaleClients
    WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM FemaleClients)
),
HighestLowestSalaries AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(AvgSalary) as MaxAvgSalary,
        MIN(AvgSalary) as MinAvgSalary
    FROM OldestFemaleClients
)
SELECT MaxAvgSalary - MinAvgSalary as SalaryGap;

WITH oldest_females AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, d.A11
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MAX(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
    )
),
lowest_salary AS (
    SELECT MIN(A11) AS min_avg_salary
    FROM oldest_females
),
highest_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(A11) AS max_avg_salary
    FROM oldest_females
)
SELECT o.client_id, h.max_avg_salary - l.min_avg_salary AS salary_gap
FROM oldest_females o, highest_salary h, lowest_salary l;

WITH OldestFemaleClient AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, d.A11 AS average_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
SalaryExtremes AS (
    SELECT MAX(A11) AS max_average_salary, MIN(A11) AS min_average_salary
    FROM district
)
SELECT 
    OldestFemaleClient.client_id,
    SalaryExtremes.max_average_salary - SalaryExtremes.min_average_salary AS salary_difference
FROM OldestFemaleClient, SalaryExtremes;

WITH MinBirthDate AS (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS min_birth_date FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'
),
OldestClients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, d.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN MinBirthDate mbd ON c.birth_date = mbd.min_birth_date
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
MaxAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT MAX(d.A11) AS max_avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
MinAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.A11) AS min_avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
)
SELECT ac.account_id, mas.max_avg_salary - masd.min_avg_salary AS salary_difference
FROM OldestClients oc
JOIN account ac ON oc.client_id = ac.account_id
CROSS JOIN MaxAvgSalary mas
CROSS JOIN MinAvgSalary masd;

WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        AVG(d.A11) AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        client c
    JOIN 
        disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY 
        c.client_id
),
RankedSalaries AS (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        avg_salary,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_salary ASC) AS rank_asc,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_salary DESC) AS rank_desc
    FROM 
        FemaleClients
)
SELECT 
    MAX(avg_salary) - MIN(avg_salary) AS salary_gap
FROM 
    RankedSalaries;

FROM 
  yearmonth ym
JOIN 
  customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
  SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -

FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE 
    ym.Date LIKE '2012%';

SELECT

JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012';

WITH CustomerSegmentation AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        customers c
    JOIN 
        yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT TotalConsumption FROM CustomerSegmentation WHERE Segment = 'CZK') -
    (SELECT TotalConsumption FROM CustomerSegmentation WHERE Segment = 'EUR') AS ConsumptionDifference;

WITH CustomerCurrency AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 'CZK'
            ELSE 'EUR'
        END AS CurrencyGroup
    FROM customers c
),
YearMonthData AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
TotalConsumptionPerCurrency AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.CurrencyGroup,
        SUM(yd.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM CustomerCurrency cc
    INNER JOIN YearMonthData yd ON cc.CustomerID = yd.CustomerID
    GROUP BY cc.CurrencyGroup
)
SELECT 
    tcpc.CZK - tcpc.EUR AS ConsumptionDifference
FROM TotalConsumptionPerCurrency tcpc;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -

FROM 
    customers AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
    T2.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212';

SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS loss_count
FROM 
    Match M
JOIN 
    Team T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE 
    M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal
GROUP BY 
    T.team_short_name
ORDER BY 
    loss_count ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.team_short_name AS home_team
FROM (
    SELECT m.home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS loss_count
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal
    GROUP BY m.home_team_api_id
) AS losses_per_team
JOIN Team t ON losses_per_team.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE losses_per_team.loss_count = (
    SELECT MIN(loss_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT m.home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS loss_count
        FROM Match m
        WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal
        GROUP BY m.home_team_api_id
    )
);

ORDER BY losses_count ASC

WITH RankedClients AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.district_id ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC) AS birth_rank
    FROM 
        client c
),
AverageSalary AS (
    SELECT 
        rc.client_id,
        d.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        RankedClients rc
    JOIN 
        district d ON rc.client_id = d.district_id
    WHERE 
        rc.birth_rank = 1
),
HighestAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT 
        asal.client_id,
        asal.avg_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY asal.avg_salary DESC) AS salary_rank
    FROM 
        AverageSalary asal
)
SELECT 
    a.account_id
FROM 
    HighestAvgSalary hasal
JOIN 
    account a ON hasal.client_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    hasal.salary_rank = 1;

WITH RankedClients AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        d.A11 AS avg_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.district_id ORDER BY c.birth_date DESC) AS age_rank
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
),
FilteredYoungestClients AS (
    SELECT 
        rc.client_id,
        rc.avg_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rc.avg_salary DESC) AS salary_rank
    FROM RankedClients rc
    WHERE rc.age_rank = 1
)
SELECT fyc.client_id
FROM FilteredYoungestClients fyc
WHERE fyc.salary_rank = 1;

WITH youngest_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client
    )
),
max_avg_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(avg_salary) AS max_avg_salary
    FROM youngest_clients
),
youngest_max_avg_salary_clients AS (
    SELECT yc.client_id
    FROM youngest_clients yc
    JOIN max_avg_salary mas ON yc.avg_salary = mas.max_avg_salary
)
SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN youngest_max_avg_salary_clients ymc ON a.client_id = ymc.client_id;

WITH YoungestClients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A11 as avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client)
),
RankedClients AS (
    SELECT yc.client_id, yc.avg_salary
    FROM YoungestClients yc
    ORDER BY yc.avg_salary DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT a.account_id
FROM RankedClients rc
JOIN client c ON rc.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON c.client_id = a.account_id;

WITH YearlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS Year,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN 
        customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY 
        strftime('%Y', t.Date)
),
MaxYear AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(TotalConsumption) AS MaxTotalConsumption
    FROM 
        YearlyConsumption
)
SELECT 
    yc.Year
FROM 
    YearlyConsumption yc
JOIN 
    MaxYear my ON yc.TotalConsumption = my.MaxTotalConsumption;

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS Year,
    SUM(T1.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
FROM 
    transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN 
    customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
    T2.Currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%Y', T1.Date)
ORDER BY 
    TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH TotalUsageByYear AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS Year,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalUsage
    FROM 
        customers c
    INNER JOIN 
        transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY 
        Year
),
RankedYears AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        TotalUsage,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalUsage DESC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        TotalUsageByYear
)
SELECT 
    Year
FROM 
    RankedYears
WHERE 
    Rank = 1;

WITH YearlyUsage AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', T2.Date) AS Year,
        SUM(T2.Amount) AS TotalUsage
    FROM 
        transactions_1k T2
    INNER JOIN 
        customers C ON T2.CustomerID = C.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        C.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY 
        strftime('%Y', T2.Date)
),
RankedYears AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        TotalUsage,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalUsage DESC) as Rank
    FROM 
        YearlyUsage
)
SELECT 
    Year
FROM 
    RankedYears
WHERE 
    Rank = 1;

SELECT 
  strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS Year,
  SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
FROM 
  transactions_1k t
JOIN 
  customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
  c.Currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY 
  Year
ORDER BY 
  TotalConsumption DESC

) pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

WITH PenaltyStats AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        SUM(penalties) AS total_penalties
    FROM 
        Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY 
        player_api_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM

WITH PenaltySums AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        SUM(penalties) as total_penalties
    FROM 
        Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY 
        player_api_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM 
    Player p
JOIN 
    PenaltySums ps ON p.player_api_id = ps.player_api_id

WITH MaxFRPM AS (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`) AS max_frpms
    FROM frpm
),
FilteredSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN MaxFRPM m ON f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = m.max_frpms
)
SELECT 
    ss.NumTstTakr
FROM FilteredSchools fs
JOIN satscores ss ON fs.CDSCode = ss.cds;

WITH RankedFRPM AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC) AS frpm_rank
    FROM 
        frpm f
),
TopRankedFRPM AS (
    SELECT 
        rf.CDSCode,
        rf.`FRPM Count (K-12)`
    FROM 
        RankedFRPM rf
    WHERE 
        rf.frpm_rank = 1
)
SELECT 
    s.NumTstTakr
FROM 
    TopRankedFRPM trf
JOIN 
    satscores s ON trf.CDSCode = s.cds;

WITH FRPM_Ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.School Name,
        f.FRPCount (K-12),
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.FRPCount (K-12) DESC) AS frpm_rank
    FROM frpm f
)
SELECT 
    s.NumTstTakr
FROM satscores s
JOIN FRPM_Ranked fr ON s.cds = fr.CDSCode
WHERE fr.frpm_rank = 1;

WITH MaxFRPM AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)") AS max_frpm_count
    FROM 
        frpm
    GROUP BY 
        CDSCode
),
TopFRPM AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)"
    FROM 
        frpm f
    INNER JOIN 
        MaxFRPM m ON f.CDSCode = m.CDSCode AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" = m.max_frpm_count
)
SELECT 
    ss.NumTstTakr
FROM 
    TopFRPM tfp
INNER JOIN 
    satscores ss ON tfp.CDSCode = ss.cds;

WITH RankedFRPM AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.FRPMCount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.FRPMCount DESC) as rank
    FROM frpm f
),
TopFRPM AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode
    FROM RankedFRPM
    WHERE rank = 1
)
SELECT 
    ss.NumTstTakr
FROM TopFRPM tf
JOIN satscores ss ON tf.CDSCode = ss.cds;

SELECT 
    l.account_id, 
    l.amount AS loan_amount, 
    a.frequency
FROM 
    loan l
INNER JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
    AND l.status = 'approved'
    AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
    AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MIN(amount) 
        FROM loan 
        WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1997' AND status = 'approved'
    );

WITH ApprovedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.account_id, 
        l.amount
    FROM 
        loan l
    WHERE 
        l.status = 'approved'
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
),
LowestAmountAccounts AS (
    SELECT 
        al.account_id
    FROM 
        ApprovedLoans al
    WHERE 
        al.amount = (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM ApprovedLoans)
)
SELECT 
    la.account_id
FROM 
    LowestAmountAccounts la
JOIN 
    account a ON la.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    a.frequency = 'Weekly';

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.account_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.amount ASC) AS rn
    FROM 
        loan l
    INNER JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE 
        strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
        AND l.status = 'approved'
        AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    rl.account_id
FROM 
    RankedLoans rl
WHERE 
    rl.rn = 1;

WITH ApprovedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.account_id, 
        l.amount
    FROM 
        loan l
    WHERE 
        l.status = 'approved'
        AND l.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
),
WeeklyAccounts AS (
    SELECT 
        al.account_id, 
        al.amount, 
        a.frequency
    FROM 
        ApprovedLoans al
    JOIN 
        account a ON al.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE 
        a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
MinLoanAmounts AS (
    SELECT 
        wa.account_id, 
        MIN(wa.amount) AS min_amount
    FROM 
        WeeklyAccounts wa
    GROUP BY 
        wa.account_id
)
SELECT 
    wa.account_id
FROM 
    WeeklyAccounts wa
JOIN 
    MinLoanAmounts mla ON wa.account_id = mla.account_id AND wa.amount = mla.min_amount;

WITH ApprovedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.account_id,
        MIN(l.amount) AS min_amount
    FROM 
        loan l
    WHERE 
        l.status = 'approved'
        AND l.date LIKE '1997%'
    GROUP BY 
        l.account_id
),
FilteredAccounts AS (
    SELECT 
        al.account_id,
        a.frequency
    FROM 
        ApprovedLoans al
    INNER JOIN 
        account a ON al.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE 
        a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
)
SELECT 
    fa.account_id
FROM 
    FilteredAccounts fa;

        frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode

WITH MonthlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) AS Year, -- Extract the year part
        SUBSTR(T1.Date, 5, 2) AS Month, -- Extract the month part
        SUM(T1.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth T1
    INNER JOIN 
        customers T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        T2.Segment = 'SME'
        AND SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' -- Filter for the year 2013
    GROUP BY 
        SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4), SUBSTR(T1.Date, 5, 2) -- Group by year and month
),
MaxConsumptionMonth AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(TotalConsumption) AS MaxTotalConsumption
    FROM 
        MonthlyConsumption
)
SELECT 
    MC.Year || '-' || MC.Month AS PeakMonth
FROM 
    MonthlyConsumption MC
JOIN 
    MaxConsumptionMonth MCM ON MC.TotalConsumption = MCM.MaxTotalConsumption;

WITH MonthlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.Date,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        customers c
    JOIN 
        yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Segment = 'SME'
        AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' -- Extracting the year part
    GROUP BY 
        strftime('%Y-%m', ym.Date) -- Grouping by month
),
PeakMonth AS (
    SELECT 
        Date,
        TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        MonthlyConsumption
    ORDER BY

WITH MinConsumptionCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY ym.CustomerID) AS AvgAnnualConsumption
    FROM 
        customers c
    INNER JOIN 
        yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
),
MinConsumptionPerSegment AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(AvgAnnualConsumption) AS MinAvgAnnualConsumption
    FROM 
        MinConsumptionCustomers
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT MinAvgAnnualConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT MinAvgAnnualConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT MinAvgAnnualConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT MinAvgAnnualConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM;

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID, 
        c.Segment, 
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalAnnualConsumption
    FROM 
        customers c
    JOIN 
        yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY 
        c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
LowestConsumers AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        MIN(TotalAnnualConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM 
        CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment, 
        AVG(cc.TotalAnnualConsumption) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM 
        CustomerConsumption cc
    JOIN 
        LowestConsumers lc ON cc.Segment = lc.Segment AND cc.TotalAnnualConsumption = lc.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY 
        cc.Segment
)
SELECT 
    sa1.AnnualAverageConsumption - sa2.AnnualAverageConsumption AS DifferenceInAnnualAverage
FROM 
    SegmentAverages sa1
JOIN 
    SegmentAverages sa2 ON sa1.Segment != sa2.Segment
WHERE 
    (sa1.Segment, sa2.Segment) IN (('SME', 'LAM'), ('LAM', 'KAM'), ('KAM', 'SME'));

WITH Segments AS (
    SELECT Segment, AVG(TotalConsumption) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
        FROM customers c
        INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
        WHERE SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
        GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
    ) AS subquery
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
SME_Avg AS (
    SELECT AnnualAverage FROM Segments WHERE Segment = 'SME'
),
LAM_Avg AS (
    SELECT AnnualAverage FROM Segments WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
),
KAM_Avg AS (
    SELECT AnnualAverage FROM Segments WHERE Segment = 'KAM'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SME_Avg) - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM LAM_Avg) AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM LAM_Avg) - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM KAM_Avg) AS Diff_LAM_KAM;

WITH LowConsumptionCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
RankedSegments AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AnnualAverage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY AnnualAverage ASC) AS Rank
    FROM LowConsumptionCustomers
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverage ELSE NULL END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAverage ELSE NULL END) AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAverage ELSE NULL END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAverage ELSE NULL END) AS Diff_LAM_KAM
FROM RankedSegments
WHERE Rank = 1;

WITH TotalConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,
        COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)) AS YearsCovered
    FROM 
        yearmonth ym
    JOIN 
        customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN 
        transactions_1k t ON ym.CustomerID = t.CustomerID AND SUBSTR(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.Segment,
        tc.CustomerID,
        tc.TotalConsumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.Segment ORDER BY tc.TotalConsumption ASC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        TotalConsumption tc
),
FilteredRankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        rc.Segment,
        rc.CustomerID,
        rc.TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        RankedCustomers rc
    WHERE 
        rc.Rank = 1
),
AnnualAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        frc.Segment,
        SUM(frc.TotalConsumption) / COUNT(frc.CustomerID) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM 
        FilteredRankedCustomers frc
    GROUP BY 
        frc.Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM AnnualAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM AnnualAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS DifferenceSME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM AnnualAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAverageConsumption FROM AnnualAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS DifferenceLAM_KAM;

WITH YearlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2013,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2012
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
PercentageChange AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2013) * 100 AS PercentageChange
    FROM YearlyConsumption
)
SELECT 
    MAX(PercentageChange) AS MaxPercentageChange,
    MIN(PercentageChange) AS MinPercentageChange
FROM PercentageChange;

WITH YearlyConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    y.CustomerID,
    SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
    SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalYearlyConsumption
  FROM 
    yearmonth y
  INNER JOIN 
    customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY 
    y.CustomerID, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
SegmentWiseConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yc.Year = '2013' THEN yc.TotalYearlyConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Total2013Consumption,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yc.Year = '2012' THEN yc.TotalYearlyConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Total2012Consumption
  FROM 
    YearlyConsumption yc
  INNER JOIN 
    customers c ON yc.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  GROUP BY 
    c.Segment
),
PercentageChange AS (
  SELECT 
    swc.Segment,
    ((swc.Total2013Consumption - swc.Total2012Consumption) * 100.0 / swc.Total2013Consumption) AS PercentageChange
  FROM 
    SegmentWiseConsumption swc
)
SELECT 
  MAX(pc.Segment) FILTER (WHERE pc.PercentageChange = (SELECT MAX(PercentageChange) FROM PercentageChange)) AS MaxSegment,
  MIN(pc.Segment) FILTER (WHERE pc.PercentageChange = (SELECT MIN(PercentageChange) FROM PercentageChange)) AS MinSegment
FROM 
  PercentageChange pc;

WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    CAST(SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS Year,
    SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM 
    yearmonth y
  JOIN 
    customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY 
    c.Segment, Year
),
SegmentYearlyComparison AS (
  SELECT 
    sc1.Segment,
    sc1.TotalConsumption AS Consumption2012,
    sc2.TotalConsumption AS Consumption2013,
    ((sc2.TotalConsumption - sc1.TotalConsumption) / sc2.TotalConsumption) * 100 AS PercentageChange
  FROM 
    SegmentConsumption sc1
  JOIN 
    SegmentConsumption sc2 ON sc1.Segment = sc2.Segment
  WHERE 
    sc1.Year = 2012 AND sc2.Year = 2013
),
MaxMinChanges AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(PercentageChange) AS MaxChange,
    MIN(PercentageChange) AS MinChange
  FROM 
    SegmentYearlyComparison
)
SELECT 
  'The segment with the highest increase in consumption is ' || syc.Segment || ' with ' || ROUND(syc.PercentageChange, 2) || '% increase.' AS Result
FROM 
  SegmentYearlyComparison syc
JOIN 
  MaxMinChanges mmc ON syc.PercentageChange = mmc.MaxChange
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'The segment with the largest decrease in consumption is ' || syc.Segment || ' with ' || ROUND(syc.PercentageChange, 2) || '% decrease.'
FROM 
  SegmentYearlyComparison syc
JOIN 
  MaxMinChanges mmc ON syc.PercentageChange = mmc.MinChange;

WITH 
-- Extracting relevant customer segments and their consumption for 2012 and 2013
CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        customers c
    JOIN 
        yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'EUR'
        AND y.Date BETWEEN '20120101' AND '20131231'
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment, Year
),
-- Calculating total consumption per segment for 2012 and 2013
SegmentTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS Consumption2013,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS Consumption2012
    FROM 
        CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
),
-- Computing percentage increase/decrease
PercentageChange AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2013) * 100 AS PercentageChange
    FROM 
        SegmentTotals
)
-- Finding the segment with the maximum and minimum percentage changes
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN PercentageChange > 0 THEN Segment END) AS BiggestIncreaseSegment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN PercentageChange < 0 THEN Segment END) AS BiggestDecreaseSegment
FROM 
    PercentageChange
WHERE 
    Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM');

WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    CAST(SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS Year,
    SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM transactions_1k t
  INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND y.Date LIKE '2012%' OR y.Date LIKE '2013%'
  WHERE t.Price IS NOT NULL AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment, Year
),
YearlyDifference AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.Segment,
    (s1.TotalConsumption - s2.TotalConsumption) AS Difference,
    s1.TotalConsumption AS CurrentYearTotal,
    s2.TotalConsumption AS PreviousYearTotal
  FROM SegmentConsumption s1
  INNER JOIN SegmentConsumption s2 ON s1.Segment = s2.Segment AND s1.Year = 2013 AND s2.Year = 2012
),
PercentageIncrease AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    ((CurrentYearTotal - PreviousYearTotal) / CurrentYearTotal) * 100 AS PercentageChange
  FROM YearlyDifference
)
SELECT 
  Segment,
  CASE 
    WHEN MAX(PercentageChange) THEN 'Highest Increase'
    WHEN MIN(PercentageChange) THEN 'Lowest Increase'
  END AS ChangeType,
  PercentageChange
FROM PercentageIncrease
GROUP BY Segment, PercentageChange;

SELECT 
    T1.Segment, 
    MAX(((SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100) AS MaxPercentageIncrease,
    MIN(((SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100) AS MinPercentageDecrease
FROM 
    customers AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
    T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
GROUP BY 
    T1.Segment;

  AND e.type = 'Meeting';

WITH SchoolExcellence AS (
    SELECT 
        s.Phone,
        ss.NumGE1500,
        ss.NumTstTakr,
        CAST(ss.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / ss.NumTstTakr AS ExcellenceRate
    FROM 
        schools s
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
),
RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        se.Phone,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY se.ExcellenceRate DESC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        SchoolExcellence se
)
SELECT 
    rs.Phone
FROM 
    RankedSchools rs
WHERE 
    rs.Rank <= 3;

WITH SATExcellence AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.cds,
        CAST(ss.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / ss.NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
    FROM satscores ss
),
RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        se.cds,
        se.excellence_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY se.excellence_rate DESC) AS rank
    FROM SATExcellence se
)
SELECT 
    sch.Phone
FROM RankedSchools rs
JOIN schools sch ON rs.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE rs.rank <= 3;

WITH SATExcellence AS (
    SELECT 
        cds, 
        CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr AS ExcellenceRate
    FROM satscores
),
RankedSchools AS (

        cds, 
        ExcellenceRate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ExcellenceRate DESC) AS Rank
    FROM SATExcellence
)
SELECT 
    s.Phone
FROM RankedSchools rs
JOIN schools s ON rs.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE rs.Rank <= 3;

WITH SchoolExcellence AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) AS excellence_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        satscores s
),
Top3Schools AS (
    SELECT 
        se.cds
    FROM 
        SchoolExcellence se
    WHERE 
        se.rank <= 3
)
SELECT 
    sch.Phone
FROM 
    Top3Schools t3
JOIN 
    schools sch ON t3.cds = sch.CDSCode;

WITH RankedSchools AS (

SELECT pa.player_api_id

JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
    GROUP BY player_api_id
) sub ON pa.player_api_id = sub.player_api_id AND pa.overall_rating > sub.avg_rating
WHERE SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 4) = '2010';

    WHERE SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2010'

)
WHERE avg_overall_rating = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_overall_rating)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    )
);

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    THEN 'More SMEs pay in CZK than in EUR'
    ELSE 'Not More SMEs pay in CZK than in EUR'
  END AS comparison_result,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM 
  customers c
JOIN 
  transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE 
  c.Segment = 'SME';

WITH SMETransactions AS (
  SELECT t.CustomerID, c.Currency
  FROM transactions_1k t
  INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
),
CurrencyCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CZK_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EUR_Count
  FROM SMETransactions
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN CZK_Count > EUR_Count THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS More_SMEs_Pay_in_CZK,
  (CZK_Count - EUR_Count) AS Difference
FROM CurrencyCounts;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.date >= a.date
AND a.account_id = (
    SELECT l.account_id 
    FROM loan l 
    WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
)
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH BiggestLoanClient AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        l.amount AS loan_amount,
        a.date AS account_opening_date
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
    ORDER BY 
        l.amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

FirstTransactionAfterOpening AS (
    SELECT 
        t.amount
    FROM 
        BiggestLoanClient blc
    JOIN 
        trans t ON blc.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM account WHERE account_id = t.account_id)
    WHERE 
        t.date > blc.account_opening_date
    ORDER BY 
        t.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT 
    ft.amount AS "First Transaction Amount"
FROM 
    FirstTransactionAfterOpening ft;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.client_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
    FROM loan l2
)
AND t.date > a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH LargestLoan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
FirstTransactionAfterOpening AS (
    SELECT t.amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.date > a.date AND t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM LargestLoan)
    ORDER BY t.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT amount
FROM FirstTransactionAfterOpening;

WITH MaxLoanClient AS (
    SELECT 
        a.client_id,
        l.amount AS max_loan_amount
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount = (
            SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan
        )
),
RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.transaction_id,
        t.date,
        t.amount AS transaction_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mlc.client_id ORDER BY t.date ASC) AS rn
    FROM 
        MaxLoanClient mlc
    JOIN 
        account a ON mlc.client_id = a.district_id
    JOIN 
        trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE 
        t.date > a.date
)
SELECT 
    rt.transaction_amount
FROM 
    RankedTransactions rt
WHERE 
    rt.rn = 1;

WITH LAM_Customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_LAM_Customers
    FROM customers
    WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
),
High_Consumption_LAM AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS High_Consumption_Count
    FROM yearmonth ym
    INNER JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND ym.Consumption > 46.73
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(High_Consumption_LAM.High_Consumption_Count AS REAL) / LAM_Customers.Total_LAM_Customers) * 100 AS Percentage_High_Consumption
FROM LAM_Customers, High_Consumption_LAM;

WITH LAMCustomers AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
),
CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN LAMCustomers lc ON t.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
),
HighConsumers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS HighConsumersCount
    FROM CustomerConsumption cc
    WHERE cc.TotalConsumption > 46.73
),
TotalLAMCustomers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalLAMCount
    FROM LAMCustomers
)
SELECT 
    CAST(hc.HighConsumersCount AS REAL) / tlac.TotalLAMCount * 100 AS PercentHighConsumers
FROM HighConsumers hc, TotalLAMCustomers tlac;

WITH LAMCustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        customers c
    INNER JOIN 
        yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Segment = 'LAM'
    GROUP BY 
        c.CustomerID
),
FilteredCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS HighConsumptionCount
    FROM 
        LAMCustomerConsumption
    WHERE 
        TotalConsumption > 46.73
),
TotalLAMCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS TotalLAMCustomers
    FROM 
        customers
    WHERE 
        Segment = 'LAM'
)
SELECT 
    (fc.HighConsumptionCount * 100.0 / tlc.TotalLAMCustomers) AS PercentHighConsumption
FROM 
    FilteredCustomers fc,
    TotalLAMCustomers tlc;

WITH total_lam_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS total_count
  FROM customers
  WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
),
lam_consumed_more_than_threshold AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID) AS consumed_count
  FROM yearmonth T1
  INNER JOIN customers T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Consumption > 46.73
)
SELECT 
  (CAST(lam_consumed_more_than_threshold.consumed_count AS REAL) / total_lam_customers.total_count) * 100 AS percentage_of_customers_with_high_consumption
FROM total_lam_customers, lam_consumed_more_than_threshold;

WITH LAM_Customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerID
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
),
Customer_Consumption AS (
    SELECT yc.CustomerID, SUM(yc.Consumption) as Total_Consumption
    FROM yearmonth yc
    JOIN LAM_Customers lc ON yc.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
    GROUP BY yc.CustomerID
),
Above_Threshold AS (

    FROM Customer_Consumption cc
    WHERE cc.Total_Consumption > 46.73
),
Total_LAM_Customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as Total_LAM_Customers
    FROM LAM_Customers
)
SELECT 
    (at.Above_Threshold_Count * 100.0 / tlc.Total_LAM_Customers) as Percentage_Above_Threshold
FROM Above_Threshold at, Total_LAM_Customers tlc;

WITH 
-- Calculate the average price for each product
AveragePrices AS (
    SELECT 
        ProductID, 
        AVG(Price) AS AvgPrice
    FROM 
        transactions_1k
    GROUP BY 
        ProductID
),

-- Identify gas stations offering products at a price below the average price
ValueForMoneyStations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        t.GasStationID,
        g.Country
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        AveragePrices ap ON t.ProductID = ap.ProductID
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    WHERE 
        t.Price < ap.AvgPrice
)

-- Count the number of value for money stations per country
SELECT 
    Country, 
    COUNT(GasStationID) AS TotalValueForMoneyStations
FROM 
    ValueForMoneyStations
GROUP BY 
    Country;

SELECT 
    gs.Country,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalValueForMoneyGasStations
FROM 
    gasstations gs
WHERE 
    gs.Segment = 'value for money'
GROUP BY 
    gs.Country;

SELECT 
  Country,
  COUNT(GasStationID) AS TotalValueForMoneyStations
FROM 
  gasstations
WHERE 
  Segment = 'value for money'
GROUP BY 
  Country;

SELECT 
  g.Country, 
  COUNT(g.GasStationID) AS Total_GasStations
FROM 
  gasstations g
WHERE 
  g.Segment = 'value for money'
GROUP BY 
  g.Country;

WITH AvgPricePerUnit AS (
    SELECT 
        t.GasStationID,
        AVG(t.Price / t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_unit
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY 
        t.GasStationID
),
ValueForMoneyGasStations AS (
    SELECT 
        g.GasStationID,
        g.Country
    FROM 
        gasstations g
    JOIN 
        AvgPricePerUnit ap ON g.GasStationID = ap.GasStationID
    WHERE 
        ap.avg_price_per_unit < 0.5 -- Assuming a threshold of 0.5 for "good value for money"
)
SELECT 
    vfm.Country,
    COUNT(vfm.GasStationID) AS num_of_value_for_money_gas_stations
FROM 
    ValueForMoneyGasStations vfm
GROUP BY 
    vfm.Country;

SELECT g.Country, COUNT(g.GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStations
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Price / t.Amount > 0.5
GROUP BY g.Country
ORDER BY ValueForMoneyGasStations DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CustomerID) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        customers c
    INNER JOIN 
        yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        y.Date LIKE '201202%'
),
HighConsumers AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS HighConsumersCount
    FROM 
        CustomerConsumption
    WHERE 
        TotalConsumption > 528.3
)
SELECT 
    CAST(HighConsumersCount AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM CustomerConsumption) AS PercentageOfCustomersWithHighConsumption
FROM 
    HighConsumers;

WITH MonthlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth ym
    WHERE 
        ym.Date LIKE '201202%'
    GROUP BY 
        ym.CustomerID
),
HighConsumers AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.CustomerID
    FROM 
        MonthlyConsumption mc
    WHERE 
        mc.TotalConsumption > 528.3
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(hc.CustomerID) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT yc.CustomerID) AS HighConsumerPercentage
FROM 
    yearmonth yc
JOIN 
    HighConsumers hc ON yc.CustomerID = hc.CustomerID
WHERE 
    yc.Date LIKE '201202%';

SELECT 
    ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) AS PercentageHighConsumers
FROM yearmonth
WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' AND SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2) = '02';

WITH MonthlyConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM 
    yearmonth
  WHERE 
    SUBSTR(Date, 1, 6) = '201202'
  GROUP BY 
    CustomerID
),
HighConsumers AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM MonthlyConsumption) AS HighConsumerPercentage
  FROM 
    MonthlyConsumption
  WHERE 
    TotalConsumption > 528.3
)

SELECT 
  HighConsumerPercentage
FROM 
  HighConsumers;

WITH CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
),
FluorineAtoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'F'
),
NoFluorineMolecules AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id
    FROM CarcinogenicMolecules cm
    LEFT JOIN FluorineAtoms fa ON cm.molecule_id = fa.molecule_id
    WHERE fa.molecule_id IS NULL
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(nfm.molecule_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(cm.molecule_id) * 100 AS percentage_no_fluorine
FROM CarcinogenicMolecules cm
LEFT JOIN NoFluorineMolecules nfm ON cm.molecule_id = nfm.molecule_id;

WITH CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
FluorineAtoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'F'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(cm.molecule_id) - COUNT(fa.molecule_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(cm.molecule_id) AS percentage_no_fluorine
FROM CarcinogenicMolecules cm
LEFT JOIN FluorineAtoms fa ON cm.molecule_id = fa.molecule_id;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element != 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_no_fluorine
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+';

SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND atom.element = 'f') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_no_fluorine
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+';

WITH CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
TotalCarcinogenicCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
    FROM CarcinogenicMolecules
),
MoleculesWithFluorine AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cm.molecule_id
    FROM CarcinogenicMolecules cm
    INNER JOIN atom a ON cm.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'f'
)
SELECT 
    (tc.total_carcinogenic_molecules - COALESCE(COUNT(mwf.molecule_id), 0)) * 100.0 / tc.total_carcinogenic_molecules AS percentage_without_fluorine
FROM 
    TotalCarcinogenicCount tc
LEFT JOIN 
    MoleculesWithFluorine mwf ON 1=1;

WITH CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
TripleBonds AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS triple_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    JOIN CarcinogenicMolecules cm ON b.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    JOIN CarcinogenicMolecules cm ON b.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(tb.triple_bond_count) AS REAL) / SUM(t.total_bond_count) * 100 AS percent_triple_bonds
FROM TripleBonds tb
JOIN TotalBonds t ON tb.molecule_id = t.molecule_id;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percent
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+';

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN m.molecule_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id)) AS percent
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+';

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percent_triple_bonded_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+'
AND 
    b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent_triple_bonds
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS percent

WITH ApprovedLoan AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.status = 'approved'
      AND l.date = '1993-07-05'
),
ClientBalances AS (
    SELECT t.balance, t.date
    FROM trans t
    INNER JOIN ApprovedLoan al ON t.account_id = al.account_id
    WHERE t.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')
)
SELECT 
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN cb.date = '1998-12-27' THEN cb.balance END) - MAX(CASE WHEN cb.date = '1993-03-22' THEN cb.balance END)) /
     MAX(CASE WHEN cb.date = '1993-03-22' THEN cb.balance END)) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM ClientBalances cb;

WITH ApprovedLoan AS (
    SELECT 
        l.account_id,
        d.client_id
    FROM 
        loan l
    INNER JOIN 
        disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE 
        l.status = 'approved'
        AND l.date = '1993-07-05'
),
AccountBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        t.balance,
        CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END AS balance_1993_03_22,
        CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END AS balance_1998_12_27
    FROM 
        trans t
    INNER JOIN 
        ApprovedLoan al ON t.account_id = al.account_id
)
SELECT 
    ((MAX(balance_1998_12_27) - MAX(balance_1993_03_22)) / MAX(balance_1998_12_27)) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM 
    AccountBalances;

        account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id

Balances AS (

    FROM 
        trans t
    JOIN 
        ClientLoanInfo cl ON t.account_id = cl.account_id
    WHERE 
        t.date = '1993-03-22'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        t.balance AS balance_1998_12_27
    FROM 
        trans t
    JOIN 
        ClientLoanInfo cl ON t.account_id = cl.account_id
    WHERE 
        t.date = '1998-12-27'
)

SELECT

WITH 
-- Step 1: Identify the client who got a loan approved on '1993-07-05'
ApprovedLoan AS (
    SELECT d.client_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' AND l.status = 'approved'
),

-- Step 2: Fetch balances on '1993-03-22' and '1998-12-27'
AccountBalances AS (
    SELECT t.balance,
           t.date
    FROM trans t
    JOIN ApprovedLoan al ON t.account_id IN (
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        WHERE d.client_id = al.client_id
    )
    WHERE t.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')
)

-- Step 3: Calculate the increase rate of the account balance
SELECT 
    ((MAX(balance) OVER () - MIN(balance) OVER ()) / CAST(MIN(balance) OVER () AS REAL)) * 100 AS balance_increase_rate
FROM AccountBalances;

SELECT 
    ((T3.balance - T2.balance) / T2.balance) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM 
    client AS T1
JOIN 
    disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN 
    account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN 
    loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id
WHERE 
    T4.date = '1993-07-05'

    FROM

        CDSCode,

TopTwoSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,

        `Free Meal Count (K-12)`

        f.CDSCode,

        f.LowGrade,
        f.HighGrade,
        f.Enrollment_12,
        f.Free_Meal_Count_12,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY f.LowGrade, f.HighGrade ORDER BY f.Enrollment_12 DESC) AS rank

        frpm f
    INNER JOIN
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE
        f.LowGrade = '10'
        AND f.HighGrade = '11'
)

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.School Name,
        f.County Name,
        f.District Name,
        f.FRP Count (K-12),
        f.Enrollment (K-12),
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.FRP Count (K-12) DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        frpm f
    INNER JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.Doc = '66' AND f.Enrollment (K-12) > 0 AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` > 0
)
SELECT 
    rs.CDSCode,
    rs.School Name,
    rs.County Name,
    rs.District Name,
    rs.FRP Count (K-12),
    rs.Enrollment (K-12),
    CAST(rs.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / rs.Enrollment (K-12) AS EligibleFRPMRate
FROM 
    RankedSchools rs
WHERE 
    rs.rank <= 5;

WITH RankedSchools AS (

        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        frpm f
    JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.DOC = '66'
)
SELECT 
    rs.CDSCode,
    rs.School Name,
    CAST(rs.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / rs.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_reduced_price_meal_rate
FROM 
    RankedSchools rs
WHERE 
    rs.rank <= 5;

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        frpm.School Name,
        frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
        frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC) AS frpm_rank
    FROM 
        frpm
    INNER JOIN 
        schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        schools.SOC = '66'
),
TopRankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.CDSCode,
        rs."School Name",
        rs."FRPM Count (K-12)",
        rs."Enrollment (K-12)"
    FROM 
        RankedSchools rs
    WHERE 
        rs.frpm_rank <= 5
)
SELECT 
    ts."School Name",
    (ts."FRPM Count (K-12)" / ts."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligible Free or Reduced Price Meal Rate"
FROM 
    TopRankedSchools ts;

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.School Name,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
        f."Enrollment (K-12)",
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        frpm f
    JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.SOC = '66'
)
SELECT 
    rs."FRPM Count (K-12)" / rs."Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM 
    RankedSchools rs
WHERE 
    rs.rank <= 5;

WITH SchoolFRPM AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.School Name,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_count_k12,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12,
        CAST(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS frpm_eligibility_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        frpm f
    JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.SOC = '66'
)
SELECT 
    frpm_eligibility_rate
FROM 
    SchoolFRPM
WHERE 
    rank <= 5;

WITH

  FastestLapSpeed853 AS (
    SELECT T1.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results AS T1
    INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
    WHERE T2.forename = 'Paul' AND T2.surname = 'di Resta' AND T1.raceId = 853
  ),
  
  -- Get the fastest lap speed for race 854
  FastestLapSpeed854 AS (
    SELECT T1.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results AS T1
    INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
    WHERE T2.forename = 'Paul' AND T2.surname = 'di Resta' AND T1.raceId = 854
  )

-- Calculate the percentage difference
SELECT 
  ((FLS853.fastestLapSpeed - FLS854.fastestLapSpeed) / FLS853.fastestLapSpeed) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM 
  FastestLapSpeed853 AS FLS853,
  FastestLapSpeed854 AS FLS854;

SELECT 
  ((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 853 AND d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta') -
   (SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 854 AND d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta')) /
  (SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 853 AND d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta') * 100 AS percent_faster;

    SELECT r.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results r
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
    AND r.raceId = 853
),
Race854 AS (
    SELECT r.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results r
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
    AND r.raceId = 854
)
SELECT 
    ((r853.fastestLapSpeed - r854.fastestLapSpeed) / r853.fastestLapSpeed) * 100 AS percentage_faster

    Race853 r853

SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS race_completion_rate
FROM 
    drivers d
INNER JOIN 
    results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
INNER JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ra.date = '1983-07-16';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(IIF(r.time IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(d.driverId) AS RaceCompletionRate
FROM 
    drivers d
JOIN 
    results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ra.date = '1983-07-16';

WITH RaceID AS (
       SELECT raceId 
       FROM races 
       WHERE date = '1983-07-16'
   ),
   DriverCounts AS (
       SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDrivers
       FROM results r
       INNER JOIN RaceID ri ON r.raceId = ri.raceId
   ),
   CompletedDrivers AS (
       SELECT COUNT(*) AS completedDrivers
       FROM results r
       INNER JOIN RaceID ri ON r.raceId = ri.raceId
       WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
   )
   SELECT 
       CAST(cd.completedDrivers AS REAL) * 100 / dc.totalDrivers AS CompletionRate
   FROM 
       CompletedDrivers cd,
       DriverCounts dc;

WITH DriverPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        d.driverId,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_drivers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS completed_drivers
    FROM
        drivers d
    JOIN
        results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
    JOIN
        races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE
        r.date = '1983-07-16'
)
SELECT
    CAST(completed_drivers AS REAL) * 100 / total_drivers AS race_completion_rate
FROM
    DriverPerformance;

WITH RaceID AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE date = '1983-07-16'
),
TotalDrivers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS total_drivers
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM RaceID)
),
CompletedDrivers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS completed_drivers
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM RaceID) AND time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CAST(CompletedDrivers.completed_drivers AS REAL) * 100 / TotalDrivers.total_drivers AS completion_rate_percentage
FROM TotalDrivers, CompletedDrivers;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.driverid) AS percentage

WHERE T2.date = '1983-07-16';

WITH TopScoringSchool AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        ss.NumGE1500,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.NumGE1500 DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        schools s
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
)
SELECT 
    s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 AS admin_name
FROM 
    TopScoringSchool tss
INNER JOIN 
    schools s ON tss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    tss.rank = 1;

SELECT 
  GROUP_CONCAT(
    COALESCE(AdmFName1, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(AdmLName1, '') ||
    ', ' || COALESCE(AdmFName2, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(AdmLName2, '') ||
    ', ' || COALESCE(AdmFName3, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(AdmLName3, '')
  ) AS admin_names
FROM schools
WHERE School = (
  SELECT sname 
  FROM satscores 
  ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC 
  LIMIT 1
);

WITH SchoolScores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        SUM(ss.NumGE1500) AS TotalGE1500
    FROM 
        schools s
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE 
        ss.NumGE1500 > 0
    GROUP BY 
        s.CDSCode
),
RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.CDSCode,
        ss.TotalGE1500,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.TotalGE1500 DESC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        SchoolScores ss
)
SELECT 
    rs.Rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1
        ELSE ''
    END AS Admin1Name,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2
        ELSE ''
    END AS Admin2Name,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3
        ELSE ''
    END AS Admin3Name
FROM 
    RankedSchools rs
INNER JOIN 
    schools s ON rs.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    rs.Rank = 1;

WITH MaxSAT AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        MAX(NumGE1500) AS max_ge_1500
    FROM 
        satscores
    GROUP BY 
        cds
),
TopSchool AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        s.sname,
        s.dname,
        s.cname,
        ss.NumGE1500
    FROM 
        MaxSAT ms
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores ss ON ms.cds = ss.cds AND ms.max_ge_1500 = ss.NumGE1500
    INNER JOIN 
        schools s ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
)
SELECT 
    ts.sname,
    ts.dname,
    ts.cname,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1

    CASE 
        WHEN s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2
        ELSE ''
    END AS admin2_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3
        ELSE ''
    END AS admin3_name
FROM 
    TopSchool ts
INNER JOIN 
    schools s ON ts.cds = s.CDSCode;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS ChoRate
FROM 
    Patient P
JOIN 
    Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    P.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - 
          SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DecreaseRate
FROM 
    Laboratory L
JOIN 
    Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE 
    P.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS ChoRate
FROM 
    Patient P
JOIN 
    Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    P.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

WITH CholescrolData AS (
    SELECT 
        P.ID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS Nov_1981_TCHO,
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS Dec_1981_TCHO
    FROM 
        Patient P
    INNER JOIN 
        Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE 
        P.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
    GROUP BY 
        P.ID
)
SELECT 
    Nov_1981_TCHO - Dec_1981_TCHO AS CholescrolDecreaseRate
FROM 
    CholescrolData;

WITH Cholesc AS (
    SELECT P.ID, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS November,
           SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS December
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
    GROUP BY P.ID
)

SELECT November - December AS Cholesc_Drop_Rate
FROM Cholesc;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type AS most_common_bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label LIKE '%carcinogen%' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM 
    (SELECT 
         bond_type, COUNT(*) as count
     FROM 
         bond
     WHERE 
         molecule_id = 'TR010'
     GROUP BY 
         bond_type
     ORDER BY 
         count DESC
     LIMIT 1) b
JOIN 
    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type AS majority_bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label LIKE '%carcinogenic%' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
    b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY 
    b.bond_type
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type AS most_common_bond,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label LIKE '%carcinogenic%' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY 
    b.bond_type
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH BondCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_type,
        COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        m.molecule_id = 'TR010'
    GROUP BY 
        b.bond_type
),
MajorBondType AS (
    SELECT 
        bond_type
    FROM 
        BondCounts
    ORDER BY 
        bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    mbt.bond_type,
    CASE WHEN m.is_carcinogenic = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM 
    MajorBondType mbt
JOIN 
    molecule m ON m.molecule_id = 'TR010';

SELECT 
    b.bond_type AS majority_bond_type,
    IIF(m.label LIKE '%carcinogenic%', 'Yes', 'No') AS is_carcinogenic
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
    b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY 
    b.bond_type
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type, 
    COUNT(b.bond_type) AS bond_count,
    CASE WHEN m.label = 'TR010' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = 'TR010'
GROUP BY 
    b.bond_type
ORDER BY 
    bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH SchoolPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        s.Street, 
        s.City, 
        s.State, 
        s.Zip, 
        ss.NumGE1500, 
        ss.NumTstTakr,
        CAST(ss.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / ss.NumTstTakr AS ExcellenceRate
    FROM 
        schools s
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
)
SELECT 
    Street || ', ' || City || ', ' || State || ' ' || Zip AS CompleteAddress
FROM 
    SchoolPerformance
ORDER BY 
    ExcellenceRate ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RankedExcellence AS (
    SELECT 
        s.Street,
        s.City,
        s.Zip,
        s.State,
        (sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr) AS ExcellenceRate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr) ASC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        schools s
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
)
SELECT 
    Street || ', ' || City || ', ' || Zip || ', ' || State AS CompleteAddress
FROM 
    RankedExcellence
WHERE 
    Rank = 1;

    SELECT bond_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id = a1.atom_id AND atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

WITH MaxMinHeight AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(height) AS max_height, 
        MIN(height) AS min_height 
    FROM 
        Player
),
FilteredPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_api_id, 
        p.height 
    FROM 
        Player p, 
        MaxMinHeight mmh
    WHERE 
        p.height IN (mmh.max_height, mmh.min_height)
),
AverageFinishingRate AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.player_api_id, 
        AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing_rate
    FROM 
        FilteredPlayers fp
    JOIN 
        Player_Attributes pa ON fp.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    GROUP BY 
        fp.player_api_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name, 
    afr.avg_finishing_rate
FROM 
    AverageFinishingRate afr
JOIN 
    Player p ON afr.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY 
    afr.avg_finishing_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height BETWEEN (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) AND (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY avg_finishing_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH HeightFilteredPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_api_id, 
        p.player_name, 
        pa.finishing 
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.height IN ((SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player), (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player))
),
AverageFinishingRates AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id, 
        player_name, 
        AVG(finishing) AS avg_finishing 
    FROM HeightFilteredPlayers
    GROUP BY player_api_id, player_name
)
SELECT 
    player_name 
FROM AverageFinishingRates
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing_rate
FROM Player p

SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing

WITH TotalAverageScores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        s.sname,
        ss.AvgScrMath,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        ss.AvgScrWrite,
        (ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalAverageScore,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite)) AS Rank
    FROM 
        schools s
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
),
LowestScoringSchool AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        sname,
        AvgScrMath,
        TotalAverageScore
    FROM 
        TotalAverageScores
    WHERE 
        Rank = 1
)
SELECT 
    lss.AvgScrMath,
    s.County
FROM 
    LowestScoringSchool lss
INNER JOIN 
    schools s ON lss.cds = s.CDSCode;

WITH AvgScores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        AVG(s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrWrite) / 3 AS avg_score
    FROM 
        satscores s
    GROUP BY 
        s.cds
),
RankedScores AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        avg_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_score ASC) AS rank
    FROM 
        AvgScores
)
SELECT 
    ss.AvgScrMath AS avg_math_score,
    sc.County
FROM 
    RankedScores rs
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON rs.cds = ss.cds
JOIN 
    schools sc ON ss.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE 
    rs.rank = 1;

WITH TotalScores AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        AvgScrMath,
        AvgScrRead,
        AvgScrWrite,
        (AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS TotalScore
    FROM satscores
),
MinTotalScore AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        MIN(TotalScore) AS MinTotalScore
    FROM TotalScores
    GROUP BY cds
    ORDER BY MinTotalScore ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
TargetSchool AS (
    SELECT 
        ts.cds,
        ts.AvgScrMath
    FROM TotalScores ts
    INNER JOIN MinTotalScore mts ON ts.cds = mts.cds AND ts.TotalScore = mts.MinTotalScore
)
SELECT 
    ts.AvgScrMath,
    s.County
FROM TargetSchool ts
INNER JOIN schools s ON ts.cds = s.CDSCode;

WITH TotalAverageScore AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        (s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalAverageScore,
        f.County Name
    FROM 
        satscores s
    INNER JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
),
MinTotalAverageScore AS (
    SELECT 
        cds, 
        MIN(TotalAverageScore) AS MinTotalAverageScore
    FROM 
        TotalAverageScore
    GROUP BY 
        cds
    ORDER BY 
        MinTotalAverageScore ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    s.AvgScrMath,
    f."County Name"
FROM 
    satscores s
INNER JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.cds = (SELECT cds FROM MinTotalAverageScore);

),
RankedSchools AS (

WITH HighScoringSchools AS (
    -- Identify schools with at least one student scoring 1500 or higher
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        s.dname,
        s.cname,
        s.NumTstTakr,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.NumTstTakr DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        satscores s
    WHERE 
        s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
),
TopScoringSchool AS (
    -- Select the top-scoring school based on the number of test takers
    SELECT 
        hss.cds,
        hss.dname,
        hss.cname,
        hss.NumTstTakr
    FROM 
        HighScoringSchools hss
    WHERE 
        hss.rn = 1
)

    sc.City
FROM 
    TopScoringSchool tss
JOIN 
    satscores s ON tss.cds = s.cds

        SELECT MAX(NumTstTakr)
        FROM satscores
        WHERE AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite >= 1500

SELECT 
  T1.School AS School_Name,
  T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment_K_12
FROM 
  schools AS T1
INNER JOIN 
  frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
  T1.DOC = '31'
ORDER BY 
  T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC;

WITH SchoolEnrollment AS (
    SELECT 
        s.School, 
        SUM(f.Epnmrollment ('K-12')) AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.StatusType = 'Special'
        AND s.DOC = 31
    GROUP BY 
        s.School
),
RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        School, 
        TotalEnrollment,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalEnrollment DESC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        SchoolEnrollment
)
SELECT 
    School, 
    TotalEnrollment
FROM 
    RankedSchools
WHERE 
    Rank = 1;

SELECT 
  T1.School AS School_Name,
  T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment_Count
FROM
