SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_of_times
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS yearly_kickoff_total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS october_meeting_total
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
) AS totals
WHERE yearly_kickoff_total > october_meeting_total;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T2.amount ELSE 0 END) > 
         SUM(CASE WHEN T1.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN T2.amount ELSE 0 END) 
    THEN 1 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS result
FROM 
  event AS T1 
INNER JOIN 
  budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event 
WHERE 
  T2.category = 'Advertisement';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM 
    event e
INNER JOIN 
    budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE 
    b.category = 'Advertisement';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN E.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN B.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN E.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN B.amount ELSE 0 END) AS Ratio
FROM 
    budget B
INNER JOIN 
    event E ON B.link_to_event = E.event_id
WHERE 
    B.category = 'Advertisement';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND b.category = 'Advertisement' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS yearly_kickoff_budget,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND b.category = 'Advertisement' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS october_meeting_budget,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN 
             (e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' OR e.event_name = 'October Meeting') 
             AND b.category = 'Advertisement'
             AND (CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) > 
             (CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) 
           THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS count_of_times_yearly_kickoff_greater
FROM 
    event e
JOIN 
    budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event;

WITH DoubleBondCounts AS (

        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    WHERE 
        b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY 
        b.molecule_id
),
MaxDoubleBondsMolecule AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id
    FROM 
        DoubleBondCounts
    ORDER BY 
        double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    m.label = '+' AS is_carcinogenic
FROM 
    MaxDoubleBondsMolecule md
JOIN 
    molecule m ON md.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

WITH DoubleBondedMolecules AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
    FROM 
        molecule m
    JOIN 
        bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
    WHERE 
        m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
),
RankedDoubleBondedMolecules AS (
    SELECT 
        dbm.molecule_id,
        dbm.double_bond_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dbm.double_bond_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        DoubleBondedMolecules dbm
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN rdbm.rank = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM 
    RankedDoubleBondedMolecules rdbm;

    FROM bond b

),
MostDoubleBondsMolecule AS (
    SELECT 
        dbpm.molecule_id
    FROM DoubleBondsPerMolecule dbpm
    ORDER BY dbpm.double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    m.label
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN MostDoubleBondsMolecule mdbm ON m.molecule_id = mdbm.molecule_id;

JOIN DoubleBonds db ON m.molecule_id = db.molecule_id
CROSS JOIN MaxDoubleBonds md
WHERE db.double_bond_count = md.max_double_bond_count;

SELECT m.label, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RankedMathScores AS (
    SELECT 
        cds, 
        sname, 
        dname, 
       cname, 
        AvgScrMath, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC) as rank_math
    FROM satscores
)

    rs.sname
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN RankedMathScores rs ON s.CDSCode = rs.cds
WHERE rs.rank_math = 7;

)

FROM

WITH IdentifiedCustomer AS (
  SELECT CustomerID 
  FROM transactions_1k 
  WHERE Amount = 124.05 AND Date = '2012-08-24'
),
TotalExpenses AS (
  SELECT SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalSpent
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN IdentifiedCustomer ic ON t.CustomerID = ic.CustomerID
  WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31'
)
SELECT te.TotalSpent, t.Date, t.Amount
FROM TotalExpenses te
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT t.Date, t.Amount
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN IdentifiedCustomer ic ON t.CustomerID = ic.CustomerID
  WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31'
) t;

WITH IdentifiedCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID 
    FROM transactions_1k 
    WHERE Amount = 124.05 AND Date = '2012-08-24'
),
TotalSpent AS (
    SELECT SUM(t.Amount) as TotalExpenses
    FROM transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN IdentifiedCustomer ic ON t.CustomerID = ic.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31'
)
SELECT ts.TotalExpenses, t.Date, t.Amount
FROM TotalSpent ts
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT t.Date, t.Amount
    FROM transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN IdentifiedCustomer ic ON t.CustomerID = ic.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31'
) t;

WITH CustomerID AS (
  SELECT CustomerID 
  FROM transactions_1k 
  WHERE Amount = 124.05 AND Date = '2012-08-24'
),
TotalSpent AS (
  SELECT SUM(Price) as TotalSpent 
  FROM transactions_1k 
  WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM CustomerID) AND Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31'
)

SELECT T1.Date, T1.Price, T2.TotalSpent 
FROM transactions_1k T1, TotalSpent T2 
WHERE T1.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM CustomerID) AND T1.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31';

WITH TargetCustomer AS (
  SELECT 
    t.CustomerID
  FROM 
    transactions_1k t
  WHERE 
    t.Date = '2012-08-24'
    AND t.Amount = 124.05
),
CustomerTransactions AS (
  SELECT 
    t.Date, 
    SUM(t.Price) AS TotalSpent
  FROM 
    transactions_1k t
  INNER JOIN 
    TargetCustomer tc ON t.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    t.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31'
  GROUP BY 
    t.Date
)
SELECT 
  ct.Date,
  ct.TotalSpent
FROM 
  CustomerTransactions ct;

WITH CustomerInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    WHERE 
        t.Date = '2012-08-24'
        AND t.Amount = 124.05
)
SELECT 
    t.Date, 
    t.Amount, 
    SUM(t.Amount) OVER () AS TotalSpent
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    CustomerInfo ci ON t.CustomerID = ci.CustomerID
WHERE 
    t.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31';

SELECT AVG(bond_count) AS avg_bonds_per_atom
FROM (
    SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM atom AS T1
    INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
    WHERE T1.element = 'i'
    GROUP BY T1.atom_id
) AS subquery;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(bond_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS average_bonds_per_atom
FROM 
    (SELECT 
         atom.atom_id, 
         COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS bond_count
     FROM 
         atom
     LEFT JOIN 
         bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id AND atom.atom_id IN (
             SELECT connected.atom_id FROM connected WHERE connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id OR connected.atom_id2 IS NULL)
     WHERE 
         atom.element = 'i'
     GROUP BY 
         atom.atom_id) AS atom

WITH IodineAtoms AS (
    SELECT 
        a.atom_id
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.element = 'I'
),
AtomBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        ia.atom_id,
        COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM IodineAtoms ia
    LEFT JOIN connected c ON ia.atom_id = c.atom_id OR ia.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY ia.atom_id
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(ab.bond_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(ab.atom_id) AS average_bond_count
FROM AtomBonds ab;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_bonds_per_atom
FROM 
    atom a
LEFT JOIN 
    bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND (a.atom_id IN (b.bond_id, b.bond_id))
WHERE 
    a.element = 'i';

SELECT CAST(SUM(bond_counts.bond_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS avg_bonds_per_atom
FROM atom a
JOIN (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM bond b
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
) AS bond_counts ON a.molecule_id = bond_counts.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'i';

SELECT AVG(COUNT(T1.bond_id)) AS avg_bonds
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'i';

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, 
       d.nationality, 
       r.max_points
FROM (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS total_wins, MAX(points) AS max_points
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
) r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY r.total_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS Driver_Name,
    d.nationality,
    MAX(r.points) AS Max_Points
FROM 
    drivers d
INNER JOIN 
    results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE 
    r.position = 1
GROUP BY 
    d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(r.wins) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, MAX(r.points) as max_points 
FROM drivers AS d 
JOIN (
    SELECT driverId 
    FROM driverStandings 
    WHERE wins = 1 
    GROUP BY driverId 
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
    LIMIT 1
) AS ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId 
JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId 
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality;

SELECT 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS Driver, 
    d.nationality AS Nationality, 
    MAX(r.points) AS Max_Points
FROM 
    drivers d
JOIN 
    results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
GROUP BY 
    d.driverId
HAVING 
    COUNT(r.wins) = (
        SELECT 
            MAX(WinCount) 
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                COUNT(wins) AS WinCount 
            FROM 
                results 
            GROUP BY 
                driverId
        )
    );

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS Driver, d.nationality, ds.points AS MaxPoints
FROM drivers d
JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
WHERE ds.wins = (
    SELECT MAX(wins)
    FROM driverStandings
)
ORDER BY ds.points DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH FilteredSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        COUNT(CDSCode) as SchoolCount
    FROM schools

),
CountyCounts AS (
    SELECT

        SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN SchoolCount ELSE 0 END) as HumboldtCount
    FROM FilteredSchools
)
SELECT CAST(ColusaCount AS REAL) / HumboldtCount as Ratio
FROM CountyCounts;

WITH FilteredTransactions AS (
    SELECT T.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k T
    WHERE T.Date = '2012-08-25'
),
EurCustomers AS (
    SELECT C.CustomerID
    FROM FilteredTransactions FT
    INNER JOIN customers C ON FT.CustomerID = C.CustomerID
    WHERE C.Currency = 'EUR'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT EC.CustomerID) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT FT.CustomerID) AS PercentageOfEurUsers
FROM FilteredTransactions FT
LEFT JOIN EurCustomers EC ON FT.CustomerID = EC.CustomerID;

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND T2.Date = '2012-08-25') AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers) AS percentage_of_customers;

WITH 
-- Step 1: Get unique customers who made transactions on '2012-08-25'
CustomersOnDate AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
),

-- Step 2: Get the count of unique EUR users from those customers
EURUsers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS EURUserCount
    FROM CustomersOnDate cd
    INNER JOIN customers c ON cd.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
),

-- Step 3: Get the total count of unique customers on the date
TotalCustomers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS TotalCustomerCount
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
)

-- Step 4: Calculate the percentage of EUR users
SELECT 
    (CAST(eur.EURUserCount AS REAL) / tc.TotalCustomerCount) * 100 AS percentage_eur_users
FROM EURUsers eur, TotalCustomers tc;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT yc.CustomerID) AS percentage_of_customers_with_eur_currency
FROM 
    yearmonth yc
INNER JOIN 
    customers c ON yc.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
    yc.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT

WITH IdentifiedCustomer AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
      AND t.Amount = 634.8
),
YearlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', ym.Date) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', ym.Date) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN IdentifiedCustomer ic ON ym.CustomerID = ic.CustomerID
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    (yc.consumption_2012 - yc.consumption_2013) / yc.consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM YearlyConsumption yc;

WITH IdentifiedCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID 
    FROM transactions_1k 
    WHERE Amount = 634.8 AND Date = '2012-08-25'
),
YearlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(T2.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM IdentifiedCustomer T1
    JOIN yearmonth T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Date LIKE '2012-%' OR T2.Date LIKE '2013-%'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT 
    (MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE NULL END) -
     MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE NULL END)) /
    MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM YearlyConsumption;

WITH IdentifiedCustomer AS (
  SELECT 
    T1.CustomerID
  FROM transactions_1k AS T1
  WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'
    AND T1.Amount = 634.8
),
YearlyConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
    SUM(T2.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM yearmonth AS T2
  INNER JOIN IdentifiedCustomer AS IC ON T2.CustomerID = IC.CustomerID
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT 
  CAST((YC1.TotalConsumption - YC2.TotalConsumption) AS REAL) / YC1.TotalConsumption AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM YearlyConsumption AS YC1
INNER JOIN YearlyConsumption AS YC2 ON YC1.Year = '2012' AND YC2.Year = '2013';

WITH 
CustomerID AS (
  SELECT CustomerID
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE Amount = 634.8 AND Date = '2012-08-25'
),

YearlyConsumption AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) as Year, SUM(T2.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
  FROM transactions_1k T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM CustomerID)
  GROUP BY Year
)

SELECT 
  (TotalConsumption2012 - TotalConsumption2013) / CAST(TotalConsumption2012 AS REAL) AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM YearlyConsumption
WHERE Year = '2012';

SELECT 
    (subquery_2012.consumption_2012 - subquery_2013.consumption_2013) / subquery_2012.consumption_2012 AS decrease_rate
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS consumption_2012
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
) AS subquery_2012,
(
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
) AS subquery_2013;

SELECT 
    (T1.Consumption - T2.Consumption) / T1.Consumption AS ConsumptionDecreaseRate
FROM 
    yearmonth AS T1
JOIN 
    yearmonth AS T2
ON 
    T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID AND T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T2.Date = '2013-08-24'
WHERE

),
RankedStations AS (

        trps.GasStationID,

    r.year AS race_year,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name
FROM 
    drivers d
INNER JOIN 
    results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
INNER JOIN 
    races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'
    AND res.fastestLap = (
        SELECT MIN(fastestLap) 
        FROM results 
        WHERE driverId = d.driverId
    );

WITH BondElementCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id AND b.bond_id IN (
            SELECT bond_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id = a1.atom_id
        )
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND b.bond_id IN (
            SELECT bond_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id = a2.atom_id
        )
    GROUP BY 
        a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(bond_count) AS max_bond_count
    FROM 
        BondElementCounts
)
SELECT 
    (SUM(IfNULL(bec.bond_count, 0)) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)) AS percentage_of_most_common_bond
FROM 
    BondElementCounts bec
JOIN 
    MaxBondCount mbc ON bec.bond_count = mbc.max_bond_count;

WITH BondElementPairs AS (
    SELECT 
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        b.bond_id
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.molecule_id = c.atom_id AND b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
ElementPairCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        element1 || ' ' || element2 AS element_pair,
        COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM 
        BondElementPairs
    GROUP BY 
        element1, element2
),
MaxElementPair AS (
    SELECT 
        element_pair
    FROM 
        ElementPairCounts
    ORDER BY 
        pair_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bep.element1 || ' ' || bep.element2 = mep.element_pair THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM 
    BondElementPairs bep, MaxElementPair mep;

WITH 
-- Find the most common combination of atom elements
MostCommonElements AS (
    SELECT T1.element || '-' || T2.element as atom_combination
    FROM atom T1
    JOIN bond B ON T1.molecule_id = B.molecule_id
    JOIN atom T2 ON T2.molecule_id = B.molecule_id AND T2.atom_id > T1.atom_id
    GROUP BY T1.element, T2.element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

-- Count bonds involving the most common combination
BondsOfMostCommonCombination AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as count_bonds
    FROM atom T1
    JOIN bond B ON T1.molecule_id = B.molecule_id
    JOIN atom T2 ON T2.molecule_id = B.molecule_id AND T2.atom_id > T1.atom_id
    WHERE T1.element || '-' || T2.element = (SELECT atom_combination FROM MostCommonElements)
),

-- Calculate the total number of bonds
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_bonds
    FROM bond
)

-- Compute the percentage of bonds
SELECT 
    CAST(BondsOfMostCommonCombination.count_bonds AS REAL) * 100 / TotalBonds.total_bonds as percentage_of_most_common_bond
FROM BondsOfMostCommonCombination, TotalBonds;

WITH atom_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        a1.element as element1,
        a2.element as element2,
        b.bond_id
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id AND b.molecule_id IS NOT NULL
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND b.molecule_id IS NOT NULL AND a1.atom_id < a2.atom_id
),
pair_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        element1,
        element2,
        COUNT(*) as bond_count
    FROM 
        atom_pairs
    GROUP BY 
        element1, element2
)
SELECT 
    (pc.bond_count * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)) as percentage
FROM 
    pair_counts pc
ORDER BY 
    pc.bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH most_common_pair AS (
    SELECT 
        a1.element AS element1, 
        a2.element AS element2, 
        COUNT(*) as pair_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY 
        a1.element, a2.element
    ORDER BY 
        pair_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
common_bond_count AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(b.bond_id) as common_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        most_common_pair mcp ON a1.element = mcp.element1 AND a2.element = mcp.element2
),
total_bond_count AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    CAST(common_bond_count AS REAL) * 100 / total_bond_count AS percentage_of_most_common_bond
FROM 
    common_bond_count, total_bond_count;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_count = ( SELECT MAX(atom_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count FROM connected GROUP BY atom_id1, atom_id2 ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT T1.bond_id, COUNT(T3.atom_id) AS bond_count
  FROM bond AS T1
  JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
  GROUP BY T1.bond_id
);

WITH CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalSpent
    FROM transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
),
TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.CustomerID,
        cs.TotalSpent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.TotalSpent DESC) AS Rank
    FROM CustomerSpending cs
),
AveragePricePerItem AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID,
        AVG(t.Price / t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.CustomerID = (SELECT tc.CustomerID FROM TopCustomer tc WHERE tc.Rank = 1)
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    c.Currency,
    tc.CustomerID,
    tc.TotalSpent,
    api.AvgPricePerItem
FROM TopCustomer tc
JOIN AveragePricePerItem api ON tc.CustomerID = api.CustomerID
JOIN customers c ON tc.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE tc.Rank = 1;

WITH 
-- Calculate total spending per customer
TotalSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Amount) AS TotalSpent
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),

-- Rank customers by total spending
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC) AS CustomerRank
    FROM TotalSpending
),

-- Get details of the top spending customer
TopCustomerDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID,
        c.Currency,
        SUM(t.Price) AS TotalPrice,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalItems
    FROM transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN RankedCustomers rc ON t.CustomerID = rc.CustomerID
    INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE rc.CustomerRank = 1
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
)

SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    Currency,
    TotalPrice / TotalItems AS AvgPricePerItem
FROM TopCustomerDetails;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS RatioPercentage
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    County = 'Santa Clara';

WITH SantaClaraCounty AS (
    SELECT T1.CDSCode, T1.County, T1.District, T1.School, T2.`Charter Funding Type`
    FROM schools T1
    INNER JOIN frpm T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE T1.County = 'Santa Clara'
),
LocalFundingCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS LocalFundedCount
    FROM SantaClaraCounty
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Local'
),
OtherFundingCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS OtherFundedCount
    FROM SantaClaraCounty
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` != 'Local'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((LocalFundingCount.LocalFundedCount / (LocalFundingCount.LocalFundedCount + OtherFundingCount.OtherFundedCount)) * 100, 2) AS RatioPercentage
FROM LocalFundingCount, OtherFundingCount;

WITH SantaClaraCharters AS (
    SELECT 
        FundingType,
        COUNT(*) AS num_schools
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'Santa Clara' AND StatusType = 'Charter'
    GROUP BY FundingType
),
TotalLocalFunded AS (
    SELECT SUM(num_schools) AS local_funded
    FROM SantaClaraCharters
    WHERE FundingType = 'Local'
),
TotalCharterFunded AS (
    SELECT SUM(num_schools) AS total_charter
    FROM SantaClaraCharters
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((local_funded * 100.0 / total_charter), 2) AS LocalFundingRatioPercentage
FROM TotalLocalFunded, TotalCharterFunded;

WITH SantaClaraCounty AS (
    SELECT 
        T1.CDSCode,
        T1.County,
        T2.CharterFundingType
    FROM 
        schools T1
    INNER JOIN 
        frpm T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        T1.County = 'Santa Clara'
),
FundingCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN CharterFundingType = 'Local' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS LocallyFunded,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalFundingTypes
    FROM 
        SantaClaraCounty
    GROUP BY 
        CharterFundingType
)
SELECT 
    (SUM(LocallyFunded) * 100.0 / SUM(TotalFundingTypes)) AS PercentageLocallyFunded
FROM 
    FundingCounts;

    COUNT(*) AS RatioPercentage

WITH CommentCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.UserId,
        COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM 
        comments c
    GROUP BY 
        c.UserId
),
MaxCommentCount AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CommentCount) AS MaxCount
    FROM 
        CommentCounts
),
TopUsers AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.UserId
    FROM 
        CommentCounts cc
    INNER JOIN 
        MaxCommentCount mcc ON cc.CommentCount = mcc.MaxCount
)
SELECT 
    b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM 
    TopUsers tu
INNER JOIN 
    badges b ON tu.UserId = b.UserId;

WITH CommentCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.UserId, 
        COUNT(c.Id) AS comment_count
    FROM 
        comments c
    GROUP BY 
        c.UserId
),
MaxCommentCount AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(comment_count) AS max_comment_count
    FROM 
        CommentCounts
),
TopUsers AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.UserId
    FROM 
        CommentCounts cc
    CROSS JOIN 
        MaxCommentCount mcc
    WHERE 
        cc.comment_count = mcc.max_comment_count
)
SELECT 
    b.Name AS BadgeName,
    b.Date AS BadgeDate,
    b.UserId
FROM 
    badges b
INNER JOIN 
    TopUsers tu ON b.UserId = tu.UserId;

SELECT b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM badges b
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT c.UserId, COUNT(c.Id) AS comment_count
    FROM comments c
    GROUP BY c.UserId
) uc ON b.UserId = uc.UserId
WHERE uc.comment_count = (
    SELECT MAX(comment_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(Id) AS comment_count
        FROM comments
        GROUP BY UserId
    )
)

SELECT u.DisplayName, b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM (
    SELECT c.UserId, COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments c
    GROUP BY c.UserId
    ORDER BY CommentCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS TopCommenter
JOIN users u ON u.Id = TopCommenter.UserId
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id;

WITH CommentCountsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        c.UserId,
        COUNT(c.Id) AS TotalComments
    FROM 
        comments c
    GROUP BY 
        c.UserId
),
MaxCommentersCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(TotalComments) AS MaxComments
    FROM 
        CommentCountsCTE
)
SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM 
    CommentCountsCTE cc
JOIN 
    MaxCommentersCTE mc ON cc.TotalComments = mc.MaxComments
JOIN 
    users u ON cc.UserId = u.Id
LEFT JOIN 
    badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId;

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, b.Name
FROM users u
JOIN (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
    ORDER BY CommentCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
) c ON u.Id = c.UserId
LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId;

WITH BadgeCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS StudentBadges_2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS StudentBadges_2011,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalBadges
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student'
),
PercentageDifference AS (
    SELECT 
        ((StudentBadges_2010 / CAST(TotalBadges AS REAL)) * 100) - 
        ((StudentBadges_2011 / CAST(TotalBadges AS REAL)) * 100) AS Diff_Percentage
    FROM BadgeCounts
)
SELECT Diff_Percentage FROM PercentageDifference;

WITH BadgeCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS StudentBadges2010,
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS StudentBadges2011,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalStudentBadges
  FROM badges
  WHERE Name = 'Student'
)
SELECT 
  ((StudentBadges2010 / CAST(TotalStudentBadges AS REAL)) * 100 - 
   (StudentBadges2011 / CAST(TotalStudentBadges AS REAL)) * 100) AS PercentageDifference
FROM BadgeCounts;

WITH BadgeCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 END) AS Badges_2010,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 END) AS Badges_2011,
        COUNT(*) AS Total_Badges
    FROM 
        badges
    WHERE 
        Name = 'Student'
)
SELECT 
    ((Badges_2010 / CAST(Total_Badges AS REAL)) * 100) - 
    ((Badges_2011 / CAST(Total_Badges AS REAL)) * 100) AS Percentage_Difference
FROM 
    BadgeCounts;

WITH StudentBadges2010 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS StudentBadgeCount2010
    FROM badges
    WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010'
      AND Name = 'Student'
),
TotalBadges2010 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalBadgeCount2010
    FROM badges
    WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010'
),
StudentBadges2011 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS StudentBadgeCount2011
    FROM badges
    WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011'
      AND Name = 'Student'
),
TotalBadges2011 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalBadgeCount2011
    FROM badges
    WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011'
)
SELECT 
    ABS((CAST(StudentBadgeCount2010 AS REAL) / TotalBadgeCount2010) * 100 - 
        (CAST(StudentBadgeCount2011 AS REAL) / TotalBadgeCount2011) * 100) AS BadgeDifferencePercentage
FROM 
    StudentBadges2010, TotalBadges2010, StudentBadges2011, TotalBadges2011;

WITH SingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
),
TotalAtomsPerMolecule AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN SingleBondMolecules sbm ON a.molecule_id = sbm.molecule_id
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
ChlorineAtomsPerMolecule AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS cl_atom_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN SingleBondMolecules sbm ON a.molecule_id = sbm.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(cla.cl_atom_count) * 100.0 / SUM(tapm.atom_count) AS percent_cl_in_single_bond_molecules
FROM TotalAtomsPerMolecule tapm
JOIN ChlorineAtomsPerMolecule cla ON tapm.molecule_id = cla.molecule_id;

WITH SingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS T1
    INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
    WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
),
ChlorineAtoms AS (
    SELECT T1.molecule_id, SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_count, COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS total_atoms
    FROM atom AS T1
    INNER JOIN SingleBondMolecules AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
    GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(chlorine_count) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(total_atoms) AS chlorine_percentage
FROM ChlorineAtoms;

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
atoms_in_single_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT atom_id, element
    FROM atom 
    WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM single_bond_molecules)
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS percent_cl_chlorine
FROM atoms_in_single_bond_molecules;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent_cl
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    b.bond_type = '-';

WITH SingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
),
ChlorineCounts AS (
    SELECT sbm.molecule_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_count,
           COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atom_count
    FROM SingleBondMolecules sbm
    INNER JOIN atom a ON sbm.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    GROUP BY sbm.molecule_id
)
SELECT (SUM(chlorine_count) * 100.0 / SUM(total_atom_count)) AS percent_chlorine
FROM ChlorineCounts;

WITH LatestLabResults AS (
    SELECT 
        ID, 
        MAX(`Date`) AS LatestDate
    FROM 
        Laboratory
    GROUP BY 
        ID
),
FilteredPatients AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ID, 
        l.UA
    FROM 
        Patient p
    JOIN 
        LatestLabResults llr ON p.ID = llr.ID
    JOIN 
        Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID AND llr.LatestDate = l.`Date`
    WHERE 
        (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
)
SELECT 
    AVG(UA) AS AverageUAIndex
FROM 
    FilteredPatients;

WITH LatestLabData AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ID, 
        l.UA,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        Patient p
    INNER JOIN 
        Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE 
        (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR 
        (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
)
SELECT 
    AVG(UA) AS AvgUAIndex
FROM 
    LatestLabData
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

SELECT 
  AVG(l.UA) AS Average_UA_Index
FROM (
  SELECT 
    l.ID, 
    MAX(l.Date) AS Latest_Exam_Date
  FROM 
    Laboratory l
  GROUP BY 
    l.ID
) AS Latest_Laboratories
JOIN 
  Laboratory l ON Latest_Laboratories.ID = l.ID AND Latest_Laboratories.Latest_Exam_Date = l.Date
JOIN 
  Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE 
  ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5))

WITH LatestLabResults AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ID,
        l.UA,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        Patient p
    INNER JOIN 
        Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
),
FilteredLatestLabResults AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        UA
    FROM 
        LatestLabResults
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    AVG(UA) AS avg_UA
FROM 
    FilteredLatestLabResults flr
JOIN 
    Patient p ON flr.ID = p.ID
WHERE 
    (p.SEX = 'M' AND flr.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND flr.UA < 6.5);

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS Avg_UA_Index
FROM Patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS Max_Date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) l_max ON p.ID = l_max.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = l_max.ID AND l.Date = l_max.Max_Date
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5);

SELECT AVG(T2.UA) AS Average_UA
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA < 8.0) OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA < 6.5)
ORDER BY T2.Date DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH UserPosts AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(Id) > 10
),
UserVotes AS (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId, SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TotalUpVotes
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId AND v.VoteTypeId = 1
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM UserPosts)
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
),
UserAges AS (
    SELECT u.Age
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN UserPosts up ON u.Id = up.OwnerUserId
)
SELECT 
    AVG(uv.TotalUpVotes) AS AvgUpVotes,
    AVG(ua.Age) AS AvgAge
FROM UserVotes uv
INNER JOIN UserAges ua ON uv.OwnerUserId = ua.Age;

SELECT 
  AVG(u.UpVotes) AS AvgUpVotes,
  AVG(u.Age) AS AvgAge
FROM 
  users u
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    p.OwnerUserId
  FROM 
    posts p
  GROUP BY 
    p.OwnerUserId
  HAVING 
    COUNT(p.Id) > 10
) AS high_post_users ON u.Id = high_post_users.OwnerUserId;

SELECT 
  AVG(u.UpVotes) AS avg_up_votes,
  AVG(u.Age) AS avg_age
FROM 
  (
    SELECT 
      OwnerUserId
    FROM 
      posts
    GROUP BY 
      OwnerUserId
    HAVING 
      COUNT(Id) > 10
  ) AS p
JOIN 
  users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id;

SELECT 
  SUM(u.UpVotes) * 1.0 / COUNT(u.Id) AS average_up_votes,
  SUM(u.Age) * 1.0 / COUNT(u.Id) AS average_user_age
FROM 
  users u
JOIN 
  posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
GROUP BY 
  u.Id
HAVING 
  COUNT(p.Id) > 10;

SELECT 
  SUM(u.UpVotes) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS AvgUpVotes,
  SUM(u.Age) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS AvgAge
FROM 
  users u
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    p.OwnerUserId
  FROM 
    posts p
  GROUP BY 
    p.OwnerUserId
  HAVING 
    COUNT(p.Id) > 10
) active_users ON u.Id = active_users.OwnerUserId;

SELECT AVG(T2.UpVotes) AS AverageUpVotes, AVG(T1.Age) AS AverageAge
FROM users AS T1
JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
GROUP BY T1.Id
HAVING COUNT(T2.Id) > 10;

    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END AS More_Male_Patients_Than_Female
FROM 
    Patient p
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE 
    l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END) THEN 'True'
            ELSE 'False' END AS Male_Female_Creatinine_Comparison
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

WITH AbnormalCreatinine AS (
    SELECT p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
),
MaleCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS MaleCount
    FROM AbnormalCreatinine
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
),
FemaleCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS FemaleCount
    FROM AbnormalCreatinine
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN MaleCount.MaleCount > FemaleCount.FemaleCount THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END AS MoreMalesWithAbnormalCreatinine
FROM MaleCount, FemaleCount;

SELECT CASE 
        WHEN MaleCount > FemaleCount THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
       END AS IsMaleMoreThanFemale
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MaleCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FemaleCount
    FROM Patient p
    INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END) 
         THEN 'True' 
         ELSE 'False' 
       END AS Result
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
             SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'True' 
        ELSE 'False' 
    END AS Result
FROM 
    Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

WITH french_cards AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS french_count
    FROM foreign_data fd
    JOIN (
        SELECT uuid 
        FROM cards 
        WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*'
    ) c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE fd.language = 'French'
),
total_cards AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*'
)
SELECT (french_count * 100.0 / total_count) AS percentage_french
FROM french_cards, total_cards;

    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_both_elements
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE 
    b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8';

WITH MoleculesWithBond AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE atom_id IN (
        SELECT atom_id 
        FROM connected 
        WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT atom_id2 
        FROM connected 
        WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
    )
),
MoleculesWithElements AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 END) AS cl_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 END) AS c_count
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM MoleculesWithBond)
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT CASE 
         WHEN SUM(cl_count > 0 AND c_count > 0) > 0 THEN 'Yes'
         ELSE 'No'
       END AS HasChlorineAndCarbon
FROM MoleculesWithElements;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND 
              SUM(CASE WHEN a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes'
         ELSE 'No'
       END AS has_both_elements
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 AND SUM(CASE WHEN a.element IN ('Cl', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 2 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS has_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM atom 
            JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id 
            WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND atom.element = 'cl'
        ) 
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM atom 
            JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id 
            WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND atom.element = 'c'
        ) 
    THEN 'Yes' 
    ELSE 'No' 
END AS result;

WITH loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS amount_1996,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS amount_1997
    FROM 
        loan l
    INNER JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    INNER JOIN 
        client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'M'
        AND l.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
),
total_loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(amount_1996) AS total_1996,
        SUM(amount_1997) AS total_1997
    FROM 
        loan_amounts
)
SELECT 
    ((total_1997 - total_1996) / CAST(total_1996 AS REAL)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    total_loan_amounts;

WITH loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_loan_amount_1997,
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_loan_amount_1996
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'M'
        AND l.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_loan_amount_1996 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((total_loan_amount_1997 - total_loan_amount_1996) / CAST(total_loan_amount_1996 AS REAL)) * 100
    END AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan_amounts;

WITH loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_1997
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'M'
)
SELECT 
    ((amount_1997 - amount_1996) / CAST(amount_1996 AS REAL)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan_amounts;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS loan_amount_difference,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan l
INNER JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN 
    client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M';

WITH yearly_loan_sums AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(l.date, -4) AS year,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM

    JOIN

    JOIN 
        client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'M'
    GROUP BY 
        SUBSTR(l.date, -4)
)

SELECT 
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN year = '1997' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = '1996' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN year = '1996' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)) AS growth_rate
FROM 
    yearly_loan_sums;

SELECT 
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_debt,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 'All Loans Paid'
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('overdue', 'pending') THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'Not All Loans Paid'
        ELSE 'No Loans'
    END AS payment_status
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.client_id = 992;

WITH TotalDebt AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_debt
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id = 992
),
TotalPayments AS (
    SELECT SUM(payments) AS total_payments
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id = 992
)
SELECT td.total_debt,
       CASE 
           WHEN tp.total_payments >= td.total_debt THEN 'Paid'
           ELSE 'Unpaid'
       END AS status
FROM TotalDebt td, TotalPayments tp;

SELECT 
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_debt,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.payments >= (l.amount / l.duration) THEN 'On Time'
        ELSE 'Late'
    END AS payment_status
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE 
    d.client_id = 992;

SELECT

        ELSE 'On Time'
    END AS payment_status
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.client_id = 992;

SELECT 
    m.label || ': ' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS hydrogen_ratio
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
    a.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT 
    m.label,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS hydrogen_ratio
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= COUNT(T1.atom_id)
            THEN '+'
            ELSE '-'
    END AS ratio_label,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS hydrogen_ratio
FROM atom T1
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT 
  m.label || ': ' || ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS ratio
FROM 
  atom a
JOIN 
  molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
  m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY 
  m.label;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) || '+' || molecule.label AS result
FROM 
    atom
JOIN 
    molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE 
    atom.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.element) AS ratio,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.element) > 0.5 THEN '+' 
        ELSE '-' 
    END AS label
FROM 
    atom AS T1
JOIN 
    molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE 
    T2.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'C';

WITH CarbonMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'c'
),
BondTypes AS (
    SELECT b.bond_type
    FROM bond b
    JOIN CarbonMolecules cm ON b.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SingleBonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DoubleBonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TripleBonds
FROM BondTypes;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type 
FROM atom AS a 
JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
WHERE a.element = 'c';

WITH carbon_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'c'
),
carbon_bonds AS (
    SELECT b.bond_type
    FROM bond b
    JOIN carbon_molecules cm ON b.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 'Double'
        WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 'Single'
        WHEN bond_type = '# ' THEN 'Triple'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS bond_type
FROM carbon_bonds;

WITH carbon_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'c'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN b.bond_type = ' =' THEN 'Double Bond'
        WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 'Single Bond'
        WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 'Triple Bond'
        ELSE 'Unknown Bond Type'
    END as bond_type_description
FROM bond b
JOIN carbon_molecules cm ON b.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element 
FROM atom AS T1 
WHERE T1.molecule_id = (SELECT SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 1, 5)) 
AND T1.atom_id IN ('10', '11');

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id IN (
    SELECT SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 7, 2)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 10, 2)
);

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUBSTR(b.bond_id, 7, 2) = '10' THEN a1.element 
        WHEN SUBSTR(b.bond_id, 10, 2) = '10' THEN a2.element 
    END AS element
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON SUBSTR(b.bond_id, 7, 2) = a1.atom_id AND b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON SUBSTR(b.bond_id, 10, 2) = a2.atom_id AND b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE 
    b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 
    a.element AS atom_element
FROM 
    atom a
INNER JOIN 
    atom b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND a.atom_id = SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 7, 2)
INNER JOIN 
    atom c ON b.molecule_id = c.molecule_id AND c.atom_id = SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 10, 2)
WHERE 
    SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 1, 5) = a.molecule_id;

WITH BondDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 1, 5) AS molecule_id,
        SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 7, 2) AS atom_id,
        SUBSTR('TR001_10_11', 10, 2) AS atom_id2
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE 
        WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
        WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon'
        WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 'Hydrogen'
        WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 'Oxygen'
        WHEN a.element = 's' THEN 'Sulfur'
        WHEN a.element = 'n' THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN a.element = 'p' THEN 'Phosphorus'
        WHEN a.element = 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
        WHEN a.element = 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
        WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN 'Iodine'
        WHEN a.element = 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
        WHEN a.element = 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
        WHEN a.element = 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
        WHEN a.element = 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    END AS element_name
FROM BondDetails bd
JOIN atom a ON bd.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom b ON bd.atom_id2 = b.atom_id;

     (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery') AND date = '2013-07-12')) /
    (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') AND date = '2013-07-12') * 100 AS difference_percentage;

WITH PlayerRating AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.overall_rating,
        p.player_name
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE pa.date = '2013/7/12'
)

SELECT 
    ((SELECT overall_rating FROM PlayerRating WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') - 
    (SELECT overall_rating FROM PlayerRating WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery')) * 100.0 /
    (SELECT overall_rating FROM PlayerRating WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') AS RatingDifferencePercentage;

SELECT

      FROM Player_Attributes

    (SELECT overall_rating 
      FROM Player_Attributes 
      WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery')

    /

    CAST(SUBSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
    CAST(SUBSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) +
    CAST(SUBSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
) AS average_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM drivers T1
INNER JOIN results T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton';

WITH RaceDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.date,
        r.time,
        c.name AS circuit_name,
        c.location,
        c.country
    FROM races r
    INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
Champion AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        ds.points,
        ds.position,
        ds.positionText,
        ds.wins,
        ds.points AS total_points
    FROM driverStandings ds
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE ds.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM RaceDetails)
    ORDER BY ds.points DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
LastFinisher AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        rs.position,
        rs.positionText,
        rs.points,
        rs.laps,
        rs.fastestLapTime,
        rs.fastestLapSpeed,
        rs.statusId,
        rs.time AS finish_time
    FROM results rs
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON rs.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE rs.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM RaceDetails)
    ORDER BY rs.position DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
TimeCalculations AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.race_name,
        rd.date,
        rd.time,
        rd.circuit_name,
        rd.location,
        rd.country,
        ch.driver_name AS champion_name,
        lf.driver_name AS last_finisher_name,
        CAST(SUBSTR(ch.total_points, 1, INSTR(ch.total_points, '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(ch.total_points, INSTR(ch.total_points, '.') + 1), 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 10 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(ch.total_points, INSTR(ch.total_points, '.') + 3), 1, 3) AS INTEGER) AS champion_time_ms,
        CAST(SUBSTR(lf.finish_time, 1, INSTR(lf.finish_time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600000 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(lf.finish_time, INSTR(lf.finish_time, ':') + 1), 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(lf.finish_time, INSTR(lf.finish_time, ':') + 4), 1, 3) AS INTEGER) AS last_finisher_time_ms
    FROM RaceDetails rd
    CROSS JOIN Champion ch
    CROSS JOIN LastFinisher lf
)
SELECT 
    ((champion_time_ms - last_finisher_time_ms) * 100.0 / last_finisher_time_ms) AS time_difference_percentage
FROM TimeCalculations;

WITH RaceData AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS raceName,
        r.year,
        res.driverId,
        res.position,
        res.time,
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 7, 3) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS totalSeconds
    FROM races r
    INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008 AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
DriverPositions AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.raceName,
        rd.year,
        rd.driverId,
        rd.position,
        rd.totalSeconds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rd.raceName ORDER BY rd.position ASC) AS positionRank
    FROM RaceData rd
),
Champion AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.raceName,
        dp.year,
        dp.driverId,
        dp.totalSeconds AS championTotalSeconds
    FROM DriverPositions dp
    WHERE dp.position = 1
),
LastDriver AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.raceName,
        dp.year,
        dp.driverId,
        dp.totalSeconds AS lastDriverTotalSeconds
    FROM DriverPositions dp
    WHERE dp.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM DriverPositions)
)
SELECT 
    c.raceName,
    c.year,
    (c.championTotalSeconds - l.lastDriverTotalSeconds) / l.lastDriverTotalSeconds * 100 AS percentageFasterThanLastDriver
FROM Champion c
CROSS JOIN LastDriver l;

WITH RaceDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS raceName,
        re.driverId,
        re.position,
        re.time,
        re.milliseconds,
        re.statusId
    FROM races r
    INNER JOIN results re ON r.raceId = re.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
Champion AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.driverId AS championId,
        rd.milliseconds AS championTime
    FROM RaceDetails rd
    ORDER BY rd.milliseconds ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
LastFinishedDriver AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.driverId AS lastDriverId,
        rd.milliseconds AS lastDriverTime
    FROM RaceDetails rd
    ORDER BY rd.milliseconds DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ((ch.championTime - lfd.lastDriverTime) / lfd.lastDriverTime) * 100 AS "percentage_faster"
FROM Champion ch
CROSS JOIN LastFinishedDriver lfd;

WITH FilteredRace AS (
    SELECT r.raceId
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
      AND r.year = 2008
),
DriverTimes AS (
    SELECT res.driverId, res.position, res.time AS finish_time
    FROM results res
    INNER JOIN FilteredRace fr ON res.raceId = fr.raceId
),
FastestDriver AS (
    SELECT dt.driverId, dt.finish_time AS fastest_time
    FROM DriverTimes dt
    WHERE dt.position = 1
),
SlowestDriver AS (
    SELECT dt.driverId, dt.finish_time AS slowest_time
    FROM DriverTimes dt
    WHERE dt.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM DriverTimes)
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(fd.fastest_time AS REAL) - CAST(sd.slowest_time AS REAL)) / CAST(sd.slowest_time AS REAL) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM FastestDriver fd, SlowestDriver sd;

WITH race_data AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, res.driverId, res.time AS finishing_time
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008
),
champion_time AS (
    SELECT MIN(finishing_time) AS champion_time
    FROM race_data
),
last_driver_time AS (
    SELECT MAX(finishing_time) AS last_driver_time
    FROM race_data
)
SELECT 
    ((strftime('%s', champion_time) - strftime('%s', last_driver_time)) / strftime('%s', last_driver_time) * 100) AS percent_faster_than_last
FROM champion_time, last_driver_time;

WITH ClientAgeSalary AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        a.account_id,
        strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS age,
        d.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        client c
    JOIN 
        account a ON c.client_id = a.district_id
    JOIN 
        district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'F'
),
RankedClients AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        age,
        avg_salary,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC, avg_salary ASC) AS rank
    FROM 
        ClientAgeSalary
)
SELECT 
    account_id
FROM 
    RankedClients
WHERE 
    rank = 1;

WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, d.A11 as avg_salary, MAX(c.birth_date) OVER () as max_birth_date
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),

    SELECT client_id, avg_salary
    FROM FemaleClients

)

WITH hydrogen_counts AS (
    SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T2.atom_id) AS hydrogen_count
    FROM molecule AS T1
    JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
    WHERE T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'h'
    GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T2.atom_id) AS total_atom_count
    FROM molecule AS T1
    JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
    WHERE T1.label = '+'
    GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(hydrogen_counts.hydrogen_count) * 100.0 / SUM(total_counts.total_atom_count) AS percentage_hydrogen
FROM hydrogen_counts
JOIN total_counts ON hydrogen_counts.molecule_id = total_counts.molecule_id;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage_hydrogen_carcinogenic
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage_hydrogen_in_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM 
    molecule m
INNER JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(a.atom_id) AS REAL) / 
     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+')) * 100 AS percentage_hydrogen_in_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h';

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' AND m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_of_hydrogen_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

FROM

    results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId

    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    d.nationality = 'Japanese'

    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        COUNT(r.raceId) AS totalRaces,
        SUM(CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedRaces
    FROM 
        drivers d
    INNER JOIN 
        results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
    INNER JOIN 
        races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE 
        d.nationality = 'Japanese'
        AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
    GROUP BY 
        d.driverId
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(completedRaces) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(totalRaces) AS raceCompletionPercentage
FROM 
    DriverRaceCompletion;

SELECT 
    r.year AS Year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 7, 2)) + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 10, 3) / 1000.0)
    ) AS Average_Time_in_Seconds
FROM 
    races r
INNER JOIN 
    results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year < 1975 AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    r.year;

SELECT 
    r.year AS race_year,
    AVG(strftime('%s', res.time)) AS avg_finish_time_seconds
FROM 
    results res
INNER JOIN 
    races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year < 1975 AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    r.year;

SELECT 
    r.year AS year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 10, 3) AS REAL) / 1000
    ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM 
    results res
JOIN 
    races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    res.positionText = '1' AND
    r.year < 1975 AND
    res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    r.year;

SELECT 
    r.year,
    AVG(strftime('%s', res.time) - strftime('%s', '00:00:00')) AS avg_time_per_champion
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975 AND res.position = 1
GROUP BY r.year;

SELECT 
    r.year AS Year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(TIME.time, 1, INSTR(TIME.time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(TIME.time, INSTR(TIME.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(TIME.time, INSTR(TIME.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(TIME.time, INSTR(TIME.time, ':') + 4) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS Average_Time_in_Seconds
FROM 
    races r
JOIN 
    results TIME ON r.raceId = TIME.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year < 1975 AND TIME.position = 1 AND TIME.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    r.year;

SELECT 
    T1.year, 
    AVG(STRFTIME('%s', SUBSTR(T2.time, 4))) / 3600 AS avg_time_seconds
FROM 
    races AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid
WHERE 
    T2.position = 1 AND T1.year < 1975 AND T2.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    T1.year
ORDER BY 
    T1.year;

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T4.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT 
    atom.atom_id AS atom_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type)
     FROM bond
     WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR346') AS total_bond_types
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR346';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY 
    a.atom_id;

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.bond_type) AS unique_bond_types
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR346')
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT 
    T1.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM 
    atom AS T1
JOIN 
    bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE 
    T1.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR346')
GROUP BY 
    T1.atom_id;

SELECT 
    T1.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type) AS bond_count
FROM 
    atom AS T1
JOIN 
    connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN 
    bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE 
    T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY 
    T1.atom_id;

WITH DoubleBondedMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
),
CarcinogenicDoubleBondedMolecules AS (
    SELECT dbm.molecule_id
    FROM DoubleBondedMolecules dbm
    JOIN molecule m ON dbm.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label LIKE '+%'
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT dbm.molecule_id) AS total_double_bonded_molecules,
    COUNT(cdbm.molecule_id) AS total_carcinogenic_double_bonded_molecules
FROM DoubleBondedMolecules dbm
LEFT JOIN CarcinogenicDoubleBondedMolecules cdbm ON dbm.molecule_id = cdbm.molecule_id;

WITH CountDriversOver50LapsAndBornBefore1985 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS count_drivers_over_50_laps_and_born_before_1985
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d.dob) < '1985'
    AND ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
    AND r.laps > 50
),
TotalDriversBetween2000And2005 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS total_drivers_between_2000_and_2005
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
)
SELECT 
    CAST(cd.count_drivers_over_50_laps_and_born_before_1985 AS REAL) / td.total_drivers_between_2000_and_2005 * 100 AS percentage_drivers_over_50_laps_and_born_before_1985
FROM CountDriversOver50LapsAndBornBefore1985 cd, TotalDriversBetween2000And2005 td;

    FROM drivers d

    )
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', dob) < '1985' AND laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS percentage_of_drivers
FROM filtered_drivers;

    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 's'
) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
);

FROM molecule m

    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.element = 's'
) AND m.molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id IN (
  SELECT molecule_id 
  FROM atom 
  WHERE element != 's'
)

  WHERE bond_type != ' = '

WITH MoleculesWithoutSulphur AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element != 's' OR a.element IS NULL
),
MoleculesWithoutDoubleBonds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type != ' = ' OR b.bond_type IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM MoleculesWithoutSulphur
    INTERSECT
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM MoleculesWithoutDoubleBonds
) AS ValidMolecules;

    FROM postHistory
    WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM TargetPost)
    GROUP BY PostId
),

    WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM TargetPost)

SELECT 
    d.driverId, 
    d.nationality, 
    lt.min_time
FROM 
    drivers d
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        driverId, 
        MIN(time) AS min_time
    FROM 
        lapTimes
    GROUP BY 
        driverId
) lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE 
    d.nationality = 'German'
    AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
ORDER BY 
    lt.min_time ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RankedDrivers AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driverName,
        MIN(lt.time) AS fastestLapTime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MIN(lt.time)) AS rank
    FROM 
        drivers d
    JOIN 
        lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
    WHERE 
        d.nationality = 'German'
        AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
    GROUP BY 
        d.driverId
)
SELECT 
    driverName,
    fastestLapTime
FROM 
    RankedDrivers
WHERE 
    rank <= 3;

WITH DriverLapTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driverName,
        l.time AS lapTime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverId ORDER BY l.time ASC) as lapRank
    FROM drivers d
    INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    INNER JOIN lapTimes l ON r.raceId = l.raceId AND d.driverId = l.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
      AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
),
TopDrivers AS (
    SELECT 
        driverName,
        MIN(lapTime) AS minLapTime
    FROM DriverLapTimes
    GROUP BY driverName
)
SELECT 
    td.driverName,
    td.minLapTime
FROM TopDrivers td
ORDER BY td.minLapTime ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, MIN(l.time) AS min_time
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY min_time ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, MIN(lt.time) AS earliest_lap_time
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE SUBSTR(d.dob, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
AND d.nationality = 'German'

LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, MIN(l.time) AS earliest_lap_time
FROM drivers d
JOIN laptimes l ON d.driverid = l.driverid
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
AND d.nationality = 'German'
GROUP BY d.driverid
ORDER BY earliest_lap_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS total_elements

JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

FROM bond b

WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id AND a1.atom_id != b.atom_id1
JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND a2.atom_id != b.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

  Match M

  League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE 
  M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY 
  L.name
ORDER BY 
  total_matches DESC
LIMIT 4;

JOIN 
    League l ON m.league_id = l.id

ORDER BY 
    total_matches DESC
LIMIT 4;

WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'

    SELECT 
        l.name AS league_name,
        COUNT(m.id) AS total_matches

        "Match" m
    JOIN 
        League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE 
        m.season = '2015/2016'

)

    MatchCounts

        P.ID, 
        P.Birthday, 
        L.GPT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY L.GPT DESC) as rank
    FROM 
        Patient P
    JOIN 
        Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE 
        L.GPT < 60
)

SELECT 
    Birthday
FROM 
    RankedPatients
WHERE 
    rank <= 3;

WITH DoubleBondedAtoms AS (
    SELECT 
        a1.element AS atom1_element, 
        a2.element AS atom2_element
    FROM 
        atom a1
    INNER JOIN 
        connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    INNER JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    INNER JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE 
        b.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR024')
        AND b.bond_type = '='
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE 
        WHEN atom1_element IS NOT NULL THEN atom1_element
        ELSE atom2_element
    END AS element
FROM 
    DoubleBondedAtoms;

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM atom a1

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR024' AND b.bond_type = '=';

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) as atom_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
max_atom_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count) as max_count
    FROM atom_counts
)

FROM atom_counts ac
JOIN max_atom_count mac ON ac.atom_count = mac.max_count;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race_name, r.date, r.time
FROM races r
JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId 
    FROM drivers 
    ORDER BY dob DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    r.year, 
    r.name AS race_name, 
    r.date AS race_date, 
    r.time AS race_time
FROM races r
JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE q.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId 
    FROM drivers 
    ORDER BY dob DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS raceName, r.date AS raceDate, r.time AS raceTime
FROM races r
JOIN (
    SELECT q.raceId
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN (
        SELECT d.driverId
        FROM drivers d
        ORDER BY d.dob DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS youngest_driver ON q.driverId = youngest_driver.driverId
    ORDER BY q.number ASC
    LIMIT 1
) AS first_qualifying_race ON r.raceId = first_qualifying_race.raceId;

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule) AS percentage_of_carcinogenic_molecules_with_triple_bonded_hydrogen
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS REAL) / 
     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule)) * 100.0 AS percentage_of_carcinogenic_molecules_with_triple_bonded_hydrogen
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN 
    molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
    a.element = 'H'
    AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_carcinogenic
FROM 
    molecule m
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    a.element = 'H'
AND 
    b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'h' AND T1.bond_type = '#';

SELECT 
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS member_name,
    SUM(e.cost) AS total_expenses
FROM 
    expense e
JOIN 
    budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN 
    event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
JOIN 
    member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY 
    m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
ORDER BY 
    total_expenses DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH multiple_events AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member
    FROM expense e
    INNER JOIN event ev ON e.link_to_budget = ev.event_id
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
),

-- Step 2: Calculate total expenses for these members
total_expenses AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
    FROM expense e
    WHERE e.link_to_member IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM multiple_events)
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
)

-- Step 3 & 4: Find the member with the highest total expense
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM total_expenses te
INNER JOIN member m ON te.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE te.total_cost = (
    SELECT MAX(total_cost)
    FROM total_expenses
);

WITH MultipleEventMembers AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id
    FROM expense e
    JOIN attendance a ON e.link_to_member = a.link_to_member
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event) > 1
),
TotalExpenses AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id, SUM(e.cost) AS total_expenses
    FROM expense e
    WHERE e.link_to_member IN (SELECT member_id FROM MultipleEventMembers)
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
)
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS member_with_max_expense
FROM TotalExpenses te
JOIN member m ON te.member_id = m.member_id
ORDER BY te.total_expenses DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS member_name
FROM (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id, SUM(e.cost) AS total_expense
    FROM expense e
    INNER JOIN event ev ON e.link_to_budget = ev.event_id
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
) subquery
JOIN member m ON subquery.member_id = m.member_id
ORDER BY subquery.total_expense DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH MultipleEvents AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id, SUM(e.cost) AS total_expense

    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
)
SELECT member_id, total_expense
FROM MultipleEvents

    FROM 
        pitStops p
    JOIN 
        drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE 
        d.nationality = 'German'
        AND d.dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
        p.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
),
RankedDrivers AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        forename,
        surname,
        avg_pit_stop_duration,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_pit_stop_duration ASC) as rank
    FROM 
        DriverPitStopStats
)
SELECT 
    forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name,
    avg_pit_stop_duration
FROM 
    RankedDrivers
WHERE 
    rank <= 3;

WITH FastestLaps AS (
    -- Select the race ID, driver ID, and fastest lap time from the results table
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        MIN(lt.time) AS fastest_lap_time
    FROM 
        results r
    JOIN 
        lapTimes lt ON r.driverId = lt.driverId AND r.raceId = lt.raceId
    GROUP BY 
        r.raceId
),

RaceInfo AS (
    -- Join the races table with the circuits table to get race details
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        c.name AS circuit_name,
        r.name AS race_name,
        f.fastest_lap_time
    FROM 
        races r
    JOIN 
        circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN 
        FastestLaps f ON r.raceId = f.raceId
)

-- Filter for the race with the fastest lap at the "Austrian Grand Prix Circuit"
SELECT 
    race_name
FROM 
    RaceInfo
WHERE 
    circuit_name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit';
