WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(p.Id) AS TotalPosts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighScorePosts
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
)
SELECT 
    CAST(HighScorePosts AS REAL) * 100 / TotalPosts AS PercentageHighScorePosts
FROM stats;

WITH most_influential_user AS (
  SELECT Id 
  FROM users 
  WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
)

-- Step 2 & 3: Fetch posts by the most influential user and calculate the percentage of high-scoring posts
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(IIF(p.Score > 50, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_above_50_score
FROM posts p
JOIN most_influential_user miu ON p.OwnerUserId = miu.Id;

WITH MostInfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT Id 
    FROM users 
    WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
),
PostsByMostInfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM posts 
    WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM MostInfluentialUser)
),
PostsAboveScore50 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as HighScoreCount 
    FROM PostsByMostInfluentialUser 
    WHERE Score > 50
),
TotalPosts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as TotalPostCount 
    FROM PostsByMostInfluentialUser
)
SELECT CAST(HighScoreCount AS REAL) * 100 / TotalPostCount AS PercentageAboveThreshold
FROM PostsAboveScore50, TotalPosts;

SELECT

WITH YearlySetCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS releaseYear,
        COUNT(*) AS yearlySetCount
    FROM sets
    WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY releaseYear
),
AverageSetsPerYear AS (
    SELECT AVG(yearlySetCount) AS avgSetsPerYear
    FROM YearlySetCounts
),
SetTranslations AS (
    SELECT s.code, st.language
    FROM sets s
    INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
    WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
),
LanguageCounts AS (
    SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS languageCount
    FROM SetTranslations
    GROUP BY language
),
MostCommonLanguage AS (
    SELECT language AS mostCommonLanguage
    FROM LanguageCounts
    ORDER BY languageCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    a.avgSetsPerYear,
    m.mostCommonLanguage
FROM AverageSetsPerYear a
CROSS JOIN MostCommonLanguage m;

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS year,
    AVG(set_count) AS avg_sets_per_year,
    ft.language AS common_language
FROM (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS year,
        COUNT(s.id) AS set_count
    FROM 
        sets s
    WHERE 
        s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
        year
) yearly_set_counts
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ft.setCode,
        ft.language,
        COUNT(*) AS lang_count
    FROM 
        set_translations ft
    JOIN 
        sets s ON ft.setCode = s.code
    WHERE 
        s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
        ft.setCode, ft.language
) ft ON yearly_set_counts.year = strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate)
GROUP BY 
    yearly_set_counts.year
ORDER BY 
    yearly_set_counts.year;

SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(yearly_set_count) 
   FROM (
     SELECT strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS year, COUNT(s.id) AS yearly_set_count
     FROM sets s
     WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
     GROUP BY year
   )
  ) AS avg_sets_per_year,
  (SELECT fd.language
   FROM sets s
   JOIN foreign_data fd ON s.code = fd.multiverseid
   WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
   GROUP BY fd.language
   ORDER BY COUNT(fd.language) DESC
   LIMIT 1
  ) AS common_language;

WITH SetsPerYearCTE AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS release_year, COUNT(*) AS num_sets_released
    FROM sets 
    WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY release_year
),
LanguageCountCTE AS (
    SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS language_count
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE setCode IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT code 
        FROM sets 
        WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    )
    GROUP BY language
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(num_sets_released) FROM SetsPerYearCTE) AS avg_num_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT language FROM LanguageCountCTE ORDER BY language_count DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_language;

SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(set_count) AS avg_sets_per_year
     FROM (
         SELECT strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS release_year, COUNT(s.id) AS set_count
         FROM sets s
         WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
         GROUP BY release_year
     )) AS avg_sets_per_year,
    (SELECT fd.language
     FROM foreign_data fd
     INNER JOIN sets s ON fd.multiverseid = s.mcmId
     WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
     GROUP BY fd.language
     ORDER BY COUNT(fd.language) DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS common_language;

WITH FilteredComments AS (
    SELECT c.UserId
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
),
UsersWithZeroUpvotes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS ZeroUpvoteCount
    FROM users u
    JOIN FilteredComments fc ON u.Id = fc.UserId
    WHERE u.UpVotes = 0
),
TotalUsers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fc.UserId) AS TotalUserCount
    FROM FilteredComments fc
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(uw.ZeroUpvoteCount AS REAL) / tu.TotalUserCount * 100) AS ZeroUpvotePercentage
FROM UsersWithZeroUpvotes uw, TotalUsers tu;

SELECT

    SELECT st.setCode
    FROM set_translations st

)

    SELECT st.setCode
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.language LIKE '%Japanese%'
);

);
